The chemicals would stay in the air for same amount of time as the smoke from the BKGSS440 Smoke Grenade and damage the player for 10-15 seconds every 2-3 second, doing ( over time ) a total of 25 damage to a player's health points while doing 50 damage to a player's armor. A player using the mine would spawn with 1 mine, and the mine would be removed from play upon the player's death meaning the player would need to plant a mine after he respawned.

BF-2012 Electrical Mine:

The BF-2012 Electrical Mine is an item a player would bury in the ground. They either would produce a small electrical shock ( which other players could not see ) doing an instant 25 damage to hit points only/causing temporary blindness like the Flashbang or acting like a stationary Flashbang doing no damage but being able to blind an enemy up to five times like the Flashbang. Of the two options for the electrical mine I would have to say the second ( causing a Flashbang effect up to five times while doing no damage ) is my preferred choice of the two. The item would be triggered when stepped on.

The video was taken at my mother's house with the images taken from the video and placed as JPEG into this forum. I hope that everybody enjoys seeing my hard work even if it is not an item they desire to see in game. My thanks to the Brick-Force community for the inspiration. I look forward to seeing more entries and hope play some fun matches with you all in-game!

Well folks, after thinking about it I have decided to narrow my entry down a bit to be more specific. My entry is now the BF2012 Chemical Mine which is a mine designed to release a chemical agent, causing burns to the skin and weakening of armor. Over a 15 second period, players would take 5 damage to their HP and 7 damage to their armor every 3 seconds. While it would only take one person to trip the mine anybody who would touch the chemical cloud released by the mine would also suffer the effects of the chemicals.

A player using the mine would implant it in the space ( on top of a brick, so no planting in walls or ceilings ) they wanted. Once planted, the trip ( top of the mine ) would show above the brick it was planted in, alerting cautious players that it was there. Players could shoot the trip once to set the mine off from a safe distance, and killing the player who laid the mine would remove them from play causing the player the need to replant the mine/mines. The mine would be purchasable as a single use item or a two pack for balancing reasons.

Feel free to click on the JPEG attachments to see an up-close model of my mine ( made of electrical tape, permanent marker, paper, a permanent marker, a paper clip and a water bottle ) or watch the youtube video/read post #48 in this thread to learn more about my original thoughts of this weapon. I want to once again thank the Brick-Force community for being my inspiration in this contest. The video was recorded at my mother's home. I'm hoping to seeing more entries, as I'm curious to see what everybody comes up with.

Greetings fellow Brick-Force players!

I would like to take some time to go over the basics of Gems and upgrading items, what they do, and what types of Gems there are.

There are two classifications of Gems, Weapon and Armor. Gems can be applied to items to boost their set stats. Gems such as Small, Medium, Big, and Elite can be purchased in the item shop.

Gems are a "chance" to gain bonus stats on your items. This chance may very depending on the amount of stats you have increased on your items. Using a Gem on an item will ether give you an item property or fail. (If fail the item does not lose any properties or gain any.)

What do Gems do?

  • Apply a Weapon Gem to a Weapon to upgrade Damage, Rate of Fire, Recoil, and the Magazine
  • Apply an Equipment Gem to clothing or accessories to upgrade luck, XP, Force Points, and Armor Durability

A Small Gem can only add up to 3 property levels, you can use Small Gems to max all stats to this property level.

A Medium Gem can add up to 6 property levels, you can use Medium Gems to max all stats to this property level.

With a Big Gem you can upgrade up to 10 property levels, you can use Big Gems to max all stats to this property level.

You can combine the 3 Gems using a Small, Medium, Big, or Elite up to a maximum property level of 10.
Elite Gems allow a player to select what stats the Gem will effect, where as other Gems are a random bonus.
Elite Gems and Small Gem are trainee level (level 1) to use. Others require a rank (level) to use them, so be sure to read descriptions before purchasing.

Weapon Gems:

Small Weapon Gem: Trainee (level 1) This Gem can be applied to weapons for a random stat upgrade and can be applied up to +3 times or to reach an items property level of 3. There is a small chance that this upgrade can fail on items that have already been upgraded.

Medium Weapon Gem: Warrant Officer 4 (level 21) This Gem can be applied to an item for a random stat upgrade and can be applied up to 6 times or to reach an items property level of 6. There is a small chance that this upgrade can fail on items that have already been upgraded.

Big Weapon Gem: Captain 5 (level 35) This Gem can be applied to an item for a random stat upgrade and can be applied up to 10 times or to reach an items property level of 10. There is a small chance this upgrade can fail on items that have already been upgraded.

Elite Weapon Gem: Trainee (level 1) This Gem can be applied to an item for a stat upgrade of the player’s choice and can be applied up to 10 times. This Gem cannot fail and is purchased with Tokens.

Equipment Gems

Small Equipment Gem: Trainee (level 1) This Gem can be applied to an item for a random stat upgrade up to 3 times or to reach an items property level of 3. This Gem has a chance can fail on already upgraded items.

Medium Equipment Gem: Warrant Officer 4 (level 21) This Gem can be applied to an item for a random stat upgrade up to 6 times or to reach an items property level of 6. This Gem has a chance can fail on already enhanced items.

Big Equipment Gem: Captain 5 (level 35) This Gem can be applied to an item for a random stat upgrade up to 10 times or to reach an items property level of 10. This Gem has a chance can fail on already enhanced items.

Elite Equipment Gem: Trainee (level 1) This Gem can be applied to an item for a stat upgrade of the player’s choice and can be applied up to 10 times. This Gem cannot fail and are purchased with Tokens.

Questions about in-game ranks/levels? Please check out lunboks's guide to ranks.

Further questions can be asked below.

I hope this guide to what Gems are has helped players to understand their use. Gems allow us to gain full customization of our gear and add a nice challenging goal for us to work harder to get.

posts.h:
This week’s map is something we think Sci-Fi fans (and almost everyone else) will love: “The Grid” by Repellion.
The Grid is a fluorescent Tron-esque map with an expansive building complex, many tunnels, bridges, and even a stadium where you could imagine disc battles or a Light Cycle race taking place.

The massive and complex architecture of this virtual city will allow you to utilize the range of sniper rifles, but the flexibility of an assault rifle could also prove useful if you like to shoot both short and long range.

Account & Security

I have forgotten my password.
If you have forgotten your password, please click on the following link in order to request a new one:
http://www.brick-force.com/en/password-request

Technical Support

Will there be a Linux version in the future?
Brick-Force is built on the Unity 3D game engine, for which Linux compatibility is planned. However, there is no confirmed date of when this will happen. In the meantime, Linux users can play Brick-Force via the open source software “Wine”, however we can’t guarantee a smooth gameplay experience.

Which Operating systems are supported by Brick-Force?
Currently Brick-Force is playable on Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7. The browser version is also playable on MAC OS X.

Which Internet browser do I need to play Brick-Force?
You can play Brick-Force with most popular internet browsers such as Internet Explorer, Firefox, Chrome, Safari and Opera.

How can I play Brick-Force in my browser?
In order to play Brick-Force in your browser, you first need the Unity Web Player.
The first time you try to log into the browser version, it will automatically redirect you to the download.
Click on “Unity Web Player - Install Now” and save the installation file on your PC.
As soon as download is finished, double-click on the "UnityWebPlayer.exe" and follow through with the installation.
Then, start the Brick-Force browser version anew and reload the page. You can now log into the game with your username and password.

How can I send a request (ticket) to customer support?
In order to contact support, you will first have to log into the customer support portal with the email address and password which you used upon registration for Brick-Force.

In the next step, please click on "Submit a Ticket" to choose a department and create your ticket request.



How can I change the server which I want to buy the Tokens for?
In order to change the server which is used by default for Token purchases, you will first have to log in on our website: https://www.brick-force.com/en/login
Here, you can change the game server in the “Edit Details” section.
Whichever server you choose here will be the default server used for your next Token purchase.

How can I buy Tokens?
Tokens are sold directly on the Brick-Force website:

- http://www.brick-force.com

- Click on “Buy Tokens”

- Log in with your email address and password

- Choose the server that you normally play on (this setting will be saved after the first purchase)

- Next, you can enter your preferred means of payment

- In the last step, please choose the amount of Tokens you want to buy

Finally, you are forwarded to the selected payment provider where you can finalize the purchase.

After several minutes of processing time, the Tokens will be credited to your account.

In order for the Tokens to appear in-game, you will have to log in again.

My Tokens did not end up on my in-game account.
Token delivery can take some time. Should you have been logged in during payment, you will have to log in again so currency display can reset. Then, the Tokens should be visible for you.

If you received an error message upon buying Tokens or if they do not seem to appear on your game account after a short waiting time in spite of logging in repeatedly, please write us a ticket.

Please include the following information when writing a ticket:

- When did you buy the Tokens?

- Which payment method did you choose?

- Which server were they bought for?

- Did you receive an error message during purchase?

Do I need to terminate the subscription or does it run out on its own?
As soon as the purchase is through, it cannot be undone as the item is instantly activated. Duration depends on the package: As soon as it runs out, a new Premium item has to be bought. The term of notice is 2 weeks for all packages. Depending on the payment method, if the termination is not done on time, the subscription will be automatically prolonged by the duration of the previously used package.

Is my Premium account bound to any conditions?
The only condition is the duration itself. This depends on the package you bought. Right now, the duration period starts at the moment of your purchase. This can last 1, 3, 6 or 12 months. It is prolonged automatically when the package runs out, unless it is terminated by the user beforehand.

Which benefits do I have from upgrading my account to Premium?
Premium status includes the following features:
- The Brick-tastic Brick-Gun for free
- An item which significantly shortens your respawning time
- An item which heals you automatically once per spawn
- 2 additional map slots
- A 10% Force Point Bonus
- A 10% XP Bonus
As soon as the status package runs out or is terminated, all special features are deactivated.

What is a Premium account?
Premium status can be purchased in the shop for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months. It offers you various benefits which gamers without Premium don't have.

What happens to the items I buy during Premium status after this status end...
As soon as Premium status has ended, all special items you received for choosing Premium are deactivated. However, they remain existant in the background. If you want to use them again, you will have to get back to upgrading our account. All normal items which you might have purchased during this time are not affected by Premium status running out.

How do I get a Premium Account?
Purchase it in the shop [subcategory: 'Premium']. As soon as the purchase is finished, your account status will be switched to Premium and remain active for the duration of the package.

Head to the beach with Brick-Force!

August is here, the sun is out, and a new Brick-Force wallpaper is waiting for your desktop.

This month’s wallpaper features some of our Brick-Force soldiers seemingly on vacation, where they still can’t help but battle each other.

Give your desktop that summer feeling and we’ll be back next month with another exclusive wallpaper.

News Round-Up

You’re probably already aware of this, but Brick-Force has launched! This brought Premium accounts, permanent weapons, and much more.

Along with the launch of the game was also the launch of our social tool developed in collaboration with Overwolf, the B-Hub.

To celebrate the launch, we have a bunch of events that you can keep track of on our Event Timeline. This includes the Sharpshooter competition, Alienware raffle and both the Weapon and Outfit Design competitions.

After the cliffhanger ending of the previous episode, we come one step closer to discovering the true villain in the Brick-Force comic.

5-Star weapons were available for one weekend only in the Shop. Who knows when these will show up again?

Prestige, honor and recognition await you in the Brick Brigade.

Brick-Force Around the Web

MMORPG.com spoke with lead game designer Armin Papenfuss to discuss the various gameplay modes available and what the future holds for Brick-Force. You can read the interview here.

The launch of the game even got a bit of coverage over at Forbes.

PCGamesN has an extensive write-up covering our launch and future content releases.

Videos

The launch of the game brought with it a brand new trailer featuring footage new new features!

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_T7ZE8aeRU



HojjoshMC is back with another installment of Operation: BrickForce, providing a video roundup of the latest news and community content.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qf30hgGbo4



Spunkify and MagicMan from MMOBomb recorded a dual commentary while playing the game for your entertainment.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgnYzlT9WIg

Forum user Empress made an amazing cosplay of a Brick-Force nurse accompanied by a lifesize Bee.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b0eDx4Ix_aQ

Fan Art

At Infernum, we love to see Brick-Force fan art! Here are a few pieces we've seen across the Web.

Over on the forums, MadMadox made a sweet recruitment poster urging others to join the Brick-Force.



Tumblr user janitorjoey drew this piece below.



When thinking of ideas for the outfit design contest, GraveBear took the idea behind his username and extended is to all sorts of animal costumes with the Furry Force.



Sinyx shows off his Bee t-shirt. We hope to have more of these for the community soon.



Empress not only has the video above, but a photo of the cosplay in action.



Community Profile

As part of this feature each month, we will highlight one of our active members of the community. In this profile, we spoke to Devinn, one of our top-ranked players on the EU server who is also active on the forums. You can read his interview in the next post.

That concludes the Community Spotlight for the month of July! We hope you enjoyed, and we welcome you to let us know what types of content you would like to see in future posts.

Name: Devin
Brick-Force Username: Devinn
Age: 17

Tell us a bit about yourself.
My name is Devin and I have three brothers who also play Brick-Force. I am a competitive gamer who plays games 10-14 hours a day.

How long have you been playing Brick-Force?
Since the first day of VIP Open Beta.

How did you discover Brick-Force?
I was first saw the game on Bebopvox’s livestream and signed up for a beta key immediately afterward.

What do you like most about Brick-Force?
The Build mode offers something else that isn’t found in most first-person shooters. I really enjoy creating maps in the “sandbox” editor.

What other games do you play?
I play a lot of games, but I am currently playing Brick-Force and League of Legends the most.

When you’re not playing Brick-Force, what else are you up to?
Like a true gamer, I am either sleeping or playing League of Legends.

Build mode or Play mode, take your pick.
I like them both but I prefer the competitive nature of Play mode.

What is your most memorable experience in the game?
When I had already won a prize from playing Brick-Force during my first 30 minutes in the game.

Is there a story behind your username?
Devin was already taken, so I was forced to add another “n” to my username.

Spider-Man or Batman?
Batman, no contest.

title: Map of the Week: "High Seas" by Scarlet (US)

posts.h:
Ahoy, mateys! This week we showcase a map that provides the battlefield for the age-old debate of who is better: pirates or ninjas?

This map features two ships locked in the heat of battle at sea. What would a pirate-themed map be without treasure? Spoils await the winning team as long as they don’t get burned by the active volcano.

“High Seas” offers an equal balance of short- to long-range combat. Snipers will be comfortable aboard the ship while those looking for more close quarters combat should head to the brig.


Enjoy playing on this map, and let us know what you thought of it below!
posts.t: Map of the Week: "High Seas" by Scarlet (US)

posts.h:
I played it. And its nice. I choose the Ninja's.

WAAAAH-CHA
So happy that I made MOTW, thanks everyone!
Isn't this map like really old?
I made this map in closed beta, then remade it and edited it to be much more playable during open beta.
Great job Scarlet!!
Yay! High Seas is in MOTW!
Thanks guys
Your welcome. But spawning in a small, hot, stuffy room is a bit... ick.

You know, there has been a few ship in the sea maps before, but I like this one much more than those other bland, unbalanced ones. Normally in such a map the ships are usually so far away from each other snipers are the only weapon even worth considering, and the map is usually just camping to the extreme. However in this map it's an entirely different story, seeing as the ships are decently close together. Just like Zazzer said you can pretty much play the map with any weapon, and thankfully it's got some complexity so there's plenty of places to hang out if you're a sniper without the spots being too overpowered. Even though you spawn in fairly closed area spawn camping isn't all that easy, there's also plenty of ways to go around to flank your opponent. The map is also very straight forward, which is another good thing about it. You'll easy know your way around within less than a minute of playing the map.

Overall the map feels nicely balanced and well thought out. It's got a nice theme going, but perhaps a little small since you won't be using outside the ships to battle often, but still, it's a nice map. Congrats on winning map of the week Scarlet.

I agree with Raven, the map is very well thought out and balanced, in both spawns and the map lengths, making it good for snipers and assault rifles or SMGs. Great job once again Scarlet, and congrats
Like the others said, the map was nicely balanced and well thought out. I especially liked how you did the sharks :P.

Thanks everyone, I'm so glad this map turned out to be enjoyable to play on, that was always my top priority, a mix of playability and fun design elements (I enjoy roleplaying this map, complete with pirate and ninja sound effects while playing)

title: Feedback - Pay 2 Win, hackers, ONLY Tokens offers, unfair contests etc.

posts.h:
I started playing this game like this was the last game. I answered on facebook for more than 2 months at EVERY SINGLE POST, I was active in-game/forums more than 7 hours each day, I was really excited about Brick-Force, really really excited and I'm not alone.

This community deserves MORE then a bunch of temporary items, unbalance and a game that's actually only for those who can pay.

I'm not saying this because I don't have money to buy tokens or I'm not a good player, no I'm saying that because I can buy tokens and I am one of the best and loyals players and it's enough, I've seen too many new players having no chance in-game because of all those hacker/tokens kids, OP weapons, EXP maps and jerks.
IT'S ENOUGH!

They're quiting like me because they have no chance to play when you start with 1000 Force-Points. This game started to go down as the live version started.

The Sharpshooter contest was a HUGE FAIL, I boosted because it was hard keeping my place with all those freaking boosters.
I can see the same thing with the Weapon/Outfit contest and probably with the rest of the upcoming "contests".

The game is not based on skill anymore, it's based on your wallet.
I know... "the game is young" yeah whatever... forget about that, it's young and started extremely bad.

I wonder if the staff give a damn about us, about the "feedback".
I've played game since 98', better games then Brick-Force, BETTER! and you know what ?
Those games had worse communities and even with that, most of them are over Brick-Force.

Live version, full of bugs.
Pay 2 Win, buy 140 armour and be happy owning new players, because you have money indeed.
Not I expect replies like "Why don't you buy tokens ?" "Why don't you stop complain ?" "Why don't you leave ?" and more like those.

Why ?
Because I belive that this game can be better, I better buy a really good game instead of tokens on Brick-Force.
I complain because I'm a player and "Brick-Force is based on players feedback" and I will leave if nothing changes and I won't be alone trust me.

I saw an AMAZING game, where I can have fun.
What's about all those "offers", they're only for those who has tokens, like always, cool good job.
I've been contacted by Zal because of my activity, now... I started to disapoint him because of my behavior.
I wanted to stay in touch with the team to help them how I can, but I've been rejected.

TOO MANY THINGS FOR THIS GAME and maybe none of them are working well.

You can't blame always something. I feel so sick of all those things that destroyed this awesome game, you have a great community, give them something else than Pay 2 win hackers and all that kind of stuff.

UPDATE:
The browser version is totally down by hackers.
Everyone started to complain about flying guys that can kill teammates and more.


I know where you can find the "guy" who made this hack... I can provide the link to their forums.

Also... sometime ago was a big issue with the Tokens, you could get 30.000 Tokens everyday, of course hacking, I know about this because from the forums where I've find about that hack.
Don't think that I hacke,d no, I just searched for proof. And there are many more...

Please... do something!

title: Map of the Week: "Kitty" by IceCream

posts.h:
This week we decided to showcase something a little bit different from our usual Map of the Week. We bring you the impressively nerdy and eye-poppingly colorful map "Kitty" by IceCream.

Trying to describe all the contents of the map would be a futile task. All we can say is – you will definitely find something you like. Are you into Street Fighter? Got you covered. Mario? Check. Space Invaders chasing Pikachu and Ash? Naturally. Link and the Triforce? Yes please! Did we miss something? You wouldn’t believe HOW MUCH!


Oh, and did we mention this map is playable in most game modes? We dare you to try and play a round, without getting repeatedly KOed while looking around with your jaw on the floor.

Have fun, wear glasses and tell us what you think below.
posts.t: Map of the Week: "Kitty" by IceCream

posts.h: A very fun map indeed, another good map in my list.
Niceeeeeeeeee

I'm not really a fan of this week's map actually. I don't mind pixel art maps, the problem is they usually care nothing for balance and devote all their time into the pixel art. The maps usually feel half finished and at times unplayable. This map is better than that, but play-wise it's just too plain for my tastes.

Normal balanced maps have at least two to three routes that usually intersect with each other. Look at Dusty and Sky Garden. Hell, even Sky Bridge has your standard three separate paths. Maps don't need that though, but they should always have multiple paths, and be well layered with lots of cool ideas in mind. For starters, you should never force people into one direction. This map sadly only offers one path, one direction to head in. There is cover, but it is minimal and hardly does any covering unless you're hugging it. You can either go on a suicide run to the other ship, or camp from yours. Those are pretty much your only options here, which makes the map stale to play on after the first time. My only complaint with these flaws is it destroys any need for strategy. It's pretty much your standard battlefield, so person with better aim will generally come out on top. It can't support lots of players either all that well.

I don't hate the map. It's just it doesn't feel all that special, it's pretty much an average map. I'm not usually impressed by pixel art either. It's easy to make, especially in a blocky game like brick-force, so it doesn't win extra points with me.

Well, I met my very first true pay-to-winner. He had a 3 stripe (or 4 stripe?) green rank, and he walked into the room with Boa and 40 armor in hand, as well as a boatload of other equipment. Even though our team had diamond rankers and brown ranks come in and out, he would just point and shoot, and he would kill instantly. The only way to win was to jump out from a corner at point blank and hope he wasn't fast enough, which succeeded around 3/9 times for me. He continued to blast through the match without a single assist and more than half his teams kills. At the end of the game, I got around 26 kills and 600 FP. He got about 32 kills and 1.5k FP. Yes, he helped to fund the game. No, he does not deserve to ruin any fun moment that the match could have had.

Now, I'm REALLY disappointed with the pay-to-win of this game. I've heard some tough arguments about it from DrRaven and thought about it for a while, but this probably has my mind set on the fact that:

1. The Boa is insta-kill to 90% of the game's players.
2. Pay to win really sucks when it's shoved in your face and kicked right in...

Anyone else have a similar story?

title: Public Test Server: Help us test new updates

posts.h:
We are preparing to launch a new version of the Brick-Force client that includes a new version of the network code, resulting in a better experience overall.

How does this affect players? We need as many as possible to play on this test client, which will be available starting today until Sunday, September 2nd.

What’s new on this test server? Aside from a smoother gameplay experience, all users will have their accounts copied over and given 30,000 Tokens to use in the Item Shop on whatever they please. All existing account data will be copied to the test server, so what is in your inventory on the live server is also available on the test server, without having to be purchased again. It is important to note that no data from the test server will be carried over to the live server.

In September’s community profile, we talk to Anixian, another one of our most active forum members. You can read his interview, along with the complete Community Spotlight, below.

News Round Up

A jaw-dropping 1,039,622 hours of Brick-Force were played during our open beta. Discover all sorts of interesting statistics in our beta infographic.

We went to Gamescom! Read up on what we brought to the show.

A new wave of functionality was brought to Brick-Force with the Brick HQ. Players can dive into all sorts of leaderboards and statistics straight from our website.

There’s been a lot of cheating and so-called “hacking” occurring in the game, leading us to implement some new measures to prevent this, with a letter to the community.

Brick-Force Around the Web

You can view our entire Gamescom presentation to the press courtesy of MMOReviews. Catch a sneak peek at upcoming content!

GamingLives checked out the game for the first time at Gamescom. See what they had to say about Brick-Force.

Fan Art

MadMadox is at it again this month with two new Brick-Force recruitment posters.

Community Profile

Name: Efe
Brick-Force Username: Anixian
Age: 15

Tell us a bit about yourself.
I live in the countryside in Turkey. I have been into gaming for a long time, having played more than 400 games from countless game consoles that either I owned or borrowed from friends. I am into architecture, instrumental music, philosophy and sometimes a bit of history. Also, I’m into anime! I draw manga characters now and then and I am thinking of working on a Brick-Force manga.

How long have you been playing Brick-Force?
Since closed beta! Loud and proud!

How did you discover Brick-Force?
By an advertisement for it. Once I saw that you could make your own maps to play on, I got right into the game!

What do you like most about Brick-Force?
Building maps, but also the kind and warm-hearted community. That is something about Brick-Force that very little gaming communities actually have. It’s a “gaming miracle” to me!

What other games do you play?
Nowadays I play games that have that creativity feature. And my old console games.

Do you rock out to any music while playing Brick-Force?
Mega Man for the win! I listen to soundtracks from the game series Mega Man X while playing. As for building, usually calm music from anime series or music that suits the map.

When you’re not playing Brick-Force, what else are you up to?
Reading books, watching anime, drawing, and sometimes just listening to music. Sometimes even playing old games. If not any of these, I enjoy going into the city with my family.

Build Mode or Shooter Mode, take your pick.
I’m more of a builder and designer. But I design to play, so Shooter mode it is!

What is your most memorable experience in the game?
I have a map that is currently a work in progress called “Matrix.” I plan on releasing it when Defense mode is released. I have been working on it since Closed Beta and people love the map, saying they are were amazed at what they saw. It really makes me feel great.

My entries in the design contests have been great, too. I really enjoy these and hope to see more.

Is there a story behind your username?
Many video games and manga are licensed or produced by Square Enix. From there I altered it to Anix. As for the “xian” part, it came from my favorite Namco Game, Galaxian.

Anyone wondering how my nickname is pronounced, it is A-nix-san. But, I prefer Anix for short.

Spider-Man or Batman?
Batman.

In today's new "Defense" update" we've added a previously unannounced feature, Pick 'N' Win.

To help eliminate some questions, I'd like to give a quick explanation of how it works and what players can "win."

  • The system has ten different boards that are shared by all players. For example, if one player removes a tile from the board, all players will see the same tile eliminated in their client.

  • To uncover a tile, players can use a Coin earned from completing the Daily Missions or by spending 250 Tokens.

  • Each board contains three rare items to be found. After all three rare items are uncovered, the board will reset.

The rare items that can be found can be seen in the table below.

Beetle 1S Tsunami 2S Rattler 42
T-Rex 42 Snow-Camo Jacket Snow-Camo Pants
Brick Corp. Scope Snow-Camo Bag Snow-Camo Cap
Snow-Camo Cartridge (L) Snow-Camo Cartridge (K)



  • The rare weapons shown above are more superior than 5-star weapons. None of these items can be purchased in the Item Shop. These rare Pick 'N' Win items are temporary and cannot be upgraded.

  • In addition, you can also win regular items in different quantities, but none of the weapons or equipment are permanent. 5-star weapons are also included in Pick 'N' Win.

Hopefully this clears up a lot of the questions about this new feature! Hope you enjoy it!

That doesn't always work. For example, the first few people that get their hands on a voucher code usually want to keep it secret so they can be one of the few people with the item. I remember when all those voucher codes used to be very hush hush. Every high ranking person wanted to know the code, but no one who knew would share. posts.h:
A bit late this month, but the Community Spotlight is here! September was quite a busy month for the Brick-Force team and Infernum Productions. Let's dive right in to the wrap-up, shall we?

News Round Up

Probably the biggest news of the month is that the Defense Update is finally here! Teased months ago, a new game mode along with a host of new features and items arrived, bringing those nefarious Bees with them.

The Summer 2012 Map Contest took place and your votes determined the best maps of the season. Check out the winners and what prizes they'll receive after the link.

A new month always brings a new wallpaper. Head over to the media section add some Brick-Force to your desktop.

We participated in the Games Developers Choice Awards. We're currently awaiting the results from the Audience Choice category. Hopefully those of you who saw this voted for us!

Agent Cooper and his troop are nearing the finale of the comic series. Get caught up with Episode 10 and 11.

Golden weapons have arrived. Plated in gold and sporting jaw-dropping stats, you can be sure everyone on the battlefield knows who is boss wit these firearms.

Brick-Force Around the Web


Total War Center called Brick-Force "one of those games you can just sit down and play for hours and hours" in the review.

Do we have any Realm of the Mad God fans? Found over on the game's official forums is a Brick-Force map inspired by the game.

Videos

Fan Art

Originally Posted by Zal
Hi Luzoto, we are actively working on ways to boost the US Brick-Force community and feel strongly that both communities should be given the same treatment. Are there any particular reasons why you feel this way? I'd like to address any concerns you might have.
I'm betting a lot of people in the U.S. have played other Free2Play MMOs before. I've played a countless amount myself, but to be quite honest, this game probably uses the F2P formula the worse. Every gun from each tier is better than the next, and the best guns are premium only. Due to how the game works, this would disappoint a LOT of U.S. players and drive them away, and chances are they'll probably tell their friends how bad this game is as well. I once tried to get my best friend to play the game, and he quickly walked away when he saw how money ended up giving power. Me and many, many other members here have been talking about balance issues, and one example of a problem a lot of people have is gems. The small gems are immediately accessible and reasonably priced, but hardly anyone will be able to reach the rankings that medium and big gems demand, and elite gems let you skip all of this. In fact, you can simply buy guns with full upgrades without having to do anything. This is a direct money-for-power formula that involves no skill whatsoever, and similar concepts have been applied to nearly every other cash shop aspect.

Now, the point of a game is to have fun. All the friends and players I know would consider fun to be being able to win by strategy and teamwork. The difference in firepower between non-payers and payers, however, is absolutely massive. I once had to battle a green-ranked soldier who seemed to have paid for his armor, as he had a Boa and 40 armor unlike most green rankers. In that one battle, he scored tops simply by walking up to the spawn of the map and quickly rightclicking, then leftclicking to destroy his enemy with ease (quickscoping). Many other players can use a Boa and/or nearly all 5-6 star weapons like this and effortlessly destroy the competition just because they dropped in ten euro. That doesn't involve skill, or strategy, or teamwork; it's just money. People I've known in the game called this a Facebook game the moment they walked into the cash shop, and that's one serious insult.

The new update gave a trailer before its release. It advertised Gravity Bricks, new types of other bricks, bounce pads, and other features. People expected these bricks to be free, as you never really had to pay much to build. Now, a number of posts clearly display the anger against that these bricks have to be paid for. Although they are available for free, the free price is so unbelievably high that I bet less than 5% of players could buy it for free, and most of us consider this another attempt to make money. The last update was also very disappointing to us, in that much of the content in the original concept trailer was removed to be replaced by a mode that is literally non existent in U.S. servers now. Seriously, though, the last few updates were entirely about 5-6 star weapons, and there's not nearly as many weapons in 1-3 star guns COMBINED than there are in 4-6 star weapons.

Although I've never played in closed beta, I heard many have been saying they enjoyed it much more than the Brick-Force of today. I'm hardly seeing anyone who isn't either new to the game or having played since that closed beta (or payers) in the U.S. server, with almost no rooms up. What I want is for Brick-Force to make the game fair enough so that non-payers are getting an equal chance, or they'll all move on to games with better Free2Play formulas. It doesn't make much sense in that the current formula only seems to attract payers, as a bigger playerbase means more new payers, right?

In short, the concept of Brick-Force is perfect. Build your own maps, and shoot the brick out of friends in them. You can't really see that concept anymore, though, through the endless amount of token items and imbalances that let you literally predict every single match simply by what a person's weapon and armor is. The only way Brick-Force is going to fix up, in my opinion, is a major re-haul of every single weapon in the game...I hope we'll be able to talk with someone who works with the prices in the game (I believe it's Product Management?), because as of late, the Community manager messages haven't been very encouraging or believable, and more and more people are leaving and giving this game a very bad reputation among reviewers like MMOHut and Metacritic...

posts.h: *slow clap* Daang, man! I read all of that, and there's some quality stuff in there! I couldn't have given that good feedback. I hope Zal or someone like that reads that wall of text, because that's impressive ^^. Fully on agree with you there, I got a cousin to play, but he quit instantly when he saw how you could basically beat 50% of Brick Force by simply paying a little. Brick Force closed-beta, as I played on that, had it right. There were no 1-hit kill melee weapons, making melee-only matches incredibly fun and tactical. The starter guns were FAR more balanced, and I LOVED using the BP40, what is now known as the Black Widow, simply because it was basically a really easy-to-use, perfectly balanced, mix-of-everything starter gun, perfect for beginners but also not powerful enough to make buying other things pointless. You couldn't arm yourself with 140 armor and 6-star space guns, as not only was that not around, but the best you could arm yourself with was a 4-star weapon unupgraded (as upgrades weren't around), allowing beginners, with well balanced, lower-tier weapondary, to stand much more of a chance and made play mode MUCH more fun for the basic fan-base. Then they released the full game. All the starter weapons were given appalling, gun-destroying nerfs in order to 'convince people to buy' the new, ridiculously powerful 5 star guns that were being pumped into the market. I love Brick Force, I really do, but Infernum should really take some lessons from its old game.

And their weapons would be more significant. I understand a few people in game have 140 armor and maxed items, but believe me IT COSTS A LOT, they deserve to have it. As for the clothing, like I suggested before, the really super unique outfits like the halloween outfits, the alien outfit should be for tokens only. The robot, professor etc... should be abailable for Force points. Maybe 30k for a complete set. Or something...

title: My opinion on the new update, and ways to fix it (and BF in general)

posts.h:
First thing before I started playing, I was excited. Space maps, more bricks, ways to delete maps. It all sounded pretty cool.
The Problem:
Now the update is out, and it seems like all these new features just cost a lot of force points and if you
want to get it quick, you need tokens. Now sure, some other games do this (like Blacklight: Retribution) but they actually do it mostly right. Now in Brick-Force, if you pay with tokens your more likely to win. I mean seriously, 4 thousand FP for 1 day for the Orion? Not to mention all the old weapons are still permanent only? 25 thousand points for a permanent mosquito/scorpion earning around 200 FP per game is about 125 games. Now, who is going to play that many games for one weapon? Don't get me started on the new weapons and there 30 day versions costing about this much. Don't get me started on adding/removing maps costing tokens and tokens only. Another example of P2W in BF is if you go into any server and you'll most likely find a user with his whole armor bar full. Now I doubt it got that all with FP don't you?

The Solution:

    Build Mode:
  • Make a choice to get the building materials with FP. We're building a map, why restrict us to paying money only on building tools?

title: What To Do If You Suspect Brick-Force is Down

posts.h:
Here you are sitting down after a long day of work or school looking to unwind with a few matches of Brick-Force. But what's this, you can't login? Infuriating!

Before you take to the forums and create one of about 20 threads on the same topic, there's a couple of things you can do to find out whether Brick-Force is actually down.

The first step would be to clear your email and password fields and try again. Maybe you mistyped? It happens to the best of us, no shame in that.

If you still cannot login, there are a couple of places you can check online before coming to the forums. Stop number one on the World Wide Web should be our main website. If we ever take the servers offline for maintenance, both planned and unplanned, we will have an alert in a big red box (so it is easy to spot!) at the top of our News postings.

If for some reason there is not an alert and you still cannot login, the next place to check would be our Twitter account. On Twitter we will always posts the same information that would appear in those website alerts.

If there is nothing you see there, then the final place to come to is here on the forums. Even then you shouldn't create a thread yet! Quickly browse and see if others are having the same issue and posting about it. It's much better to have one common thread than a smattering of multiple, short threads.

If you've done all of this and you still can't login to Brick-Force, then make a post and one of us Community Managers, or even other players, may be able to give you some information without you having to create a support ticket and wait for a response.

I hope this is very informative to everyone!

Dear community,

Would you like to be a part of the Brick-Force team? Do you enjoy helping others and feel passionate about the game? Brick-Force is looking for some fresh community moderators to help our team. You must want to:

  • Provide feedback or opinions on subjects brought up in skype group chat
  • And enjoy helping those in need.

Brick-Force in 2013
A closer look at the year ahead
January 25, 2013

Thanks to all of our fans and friends for supporting Brick-Force over the past year. It’s been a bricktastic year for us, since the launch of the closed beta back in February we have seen an overwhelming response, with over 1.5 million registered players building and blasting their way through an impressive 500,000 user-created maps. We’ve been consistently impressed by the creativity and ingenuity of our community.

In the past few months we’ve added pivotal new features such as adjustable gravity, launch pads, new outfits, weapons, exploding barrels, and a new game mode.

Our latest trailer summarizes how we feel about the year 2012:

http://m.youtube.com/#/watch?v=Mws64...layer_embedded

So, what’s next? We are not slowing down, that’s for sure. With game-changing new features and content in our upcoming add-on, the “Bricksaga” we plan to brick it to the limit in 2013. To begin with, two features that have just gone live are the new 15 second weapon change feature, where you’ll have the possibility to switch your weapons at the start of a match. We also now have a new and much improved “Quick Join” that will match you with better game rooms.

The outfit and weapon design contest winners have now seen their items officially added to the game. Congratulations to Gravebear and Matiazo! We have also been working hard on additional new outfits and “seasons” for launch during 2013. We want to polish some aspects of the UI and recently we have also taken significant action against cheating.

Later on in the year, we aim to add better community features, such as the possibility to invite your friends to a match, along with new filters, tags and even descriptions for your maps, to help put map building in the spotlight. We’re also still super excited about the prospect of an ingame achievement system and expanding our clan functionality.

Finally, we are well aware of the mobile compatibility that we announced last year. Although we’ve felt that it was important to polish some aspects of the existing game first, it is our goal to bring you mobile features for Brick-Force in 2013.

Prepare to be surprised, delighted and amazed. We think we’ve got a great year ahead.

The tab button doesn't actually work that way with pings. Unlike most other games that display your "ping" with the server, brick-force displays your ping (or response time) with each player. As your picture showed, your "ping" with every player in that game was relatively high. This is a good way to tell you your rough ping. Hey Brickforce Friends,

At the moment I'm playing at EU and US servers.
Its uncomfortable to change servers by reinstalling BF.

First what it does:
Brick-force stores the information about the current server in the registry.
Key: [HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce]
In this key, there are many subkeys, options you set.

3 of them are related to server management:
Code:
"TargetServer"="roundrobin.us.brick-force.com"
"ResourceServer"="cdn.us.brick-force.com"
"PatchServer"="patch.us.brick-force.com"
Same for EU:
Code:
"TargetServer"="roundrobin.eu.brick-force.com"
"ResourceServer"="cdn.eu.brick-force.com"
"PatchServer"="patch.eu.brick-force.com"
And you see, its pretty simple to change the server adress.
I wrote a program to make it even easier to change them.

Features:
- ofc switching between US and EU servers
- checking if laucher path is valid
- sending ping at:
-- patch server (prints offline if launcher says "cannot access the download server")
-- Resource server (for logging in)
-- Target server
- current saved ID (not really important)
- settings:
-- fullscreen
-- quality
-- hide enemy nicknames
-- hide ally nicknames
-- resolution
- UPDATED!
- Now you can choose differentlocations for your EU and US installation! (if versions dont match)

- to-do:
-- icon
-- installer
-- update function / update checker
-- better debuggin utility (to check everything is correctly set up)

Install-Video:

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDRku5y8mZE



Install-Step-by-Step:
  1. remove old brickforce installation (not important but recommended)
  2. download EU and US brickforce installer
  3. install EU, but NOT in the default directory, change "...\Brick-Force\" to "...\Brick-Force_EU\"
  4. same for US, "...\Brick-Force_US\"
  5. IF YOU HAVE NOT, INSTALL .NET FRAMEWORK! .NET 4.5
  6. open the the server changer, goto Options and press [set] behind "US Directory"
  7. navigate to where you did install your US version, by default "C:\Program Files\Brick-Force_US"
  8. again same for EU.
  9. setup other things like your ingame resolution or quality
  10. press "Save settings!"
  11. Launch!
  12. currently US downloads TONS of patches, so please be patient. the "downloading" state took me 5 minutes!
  13. (everythings should work fine, its tested. if errors occur, post them here or watch the install-video again)


Download here:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B7X...it?usp=sharing
Tested on 32 and 64 bit Windows 7.
You do NOT need to run it as Administrator!

*** Disclaimer: In no way is Infernum Products responsible for the use of this program, Infernum did not create this and will not be held accountable for any issues if caused by this program. Use at your own risk! ***

Bugs:
- After changing, Brickforce Launcher says "Downloading", then "failed".
to fix that, navigate to your install directory, for example "C:\Program Files\Brick-Force_US" and launch "BfLauncher.exe". After a sucessful start and update, you can use the serverchanger again. I dont know why this happens.

open taskmanager, CTRL+ALT+DEL, Taskmanager and end these Processes. I'll add an option in my launcher for that.

Fairly simple change, so I rewrote it in Windows Batch for funsies. I guess maybe useful for those who don't want to run executables off the Internet too, but of course I'm not accusing you or anything.



Code:
@ECHO OFF
SETLOCAL
ECHO Switch to which server?
ECHO [1] EU [2] US [3] Cancel
ECHO.
:Input
SET /P BFSERVER="Choice: "
IF NOT DEFINED BFSERVER GOTO Input
IF "%BFSERVER%"=="1" GOTO WriteEU
IF "%BFSERVER%"=="2" GOTO WriteUS
IF "%BFSERVER%"=="3" EXIT /B
GOTO Input
:WriteEU
ECHO.
ECHO Switching to EU...
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v PatchServer /d patch.eu.brick-force.com > NUL
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v ResourceServer /d cdn.eu.brick-force.com > NUL
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v TargetServer /d roundrobin.eu.brick-force.com > NUL
GOTO End
:WriteUS
ECHO.
ECHO Switching to US...
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v PatchServer /d patch.us.brick-force.com > NUL
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v ResourceServer /d cdn.us.brick-force.com > NUL
REG ADD "HKCU\Software\EXE Games\BrickForce" /f /v TargetServer /d roundrobin.us.brick-force.com > NUL
:End
ECHO Done!
ECHO.
PAUSE

Well, simple. Having +20 damage to a sniper/+10 damage/RoF/Accuracy to a mg is a much bigger advantage than having a minor FP/XP boost or having 10/20 more armor. Yes, if you wanted a weapon fully upgraded, you'd have to purchase multiple stacks to max out the stats of your weapon, but in order to have your armor/FP boost/XP boosts actually do anything, you'd also need to purchase multiple stacks. So, the prices just come down to which is better to have just 10 of. And 10 weapon gems would win by a long shot, just due to the crazy difference maxing a single weapon stat for any weapon does to said weapon.

If you know what I mean here :P.

^ The man explains it all.

In short: OP Weapons > OP Clothing.

Not that there's anything OP in upgrading weapons or clothing. If you look at the other Equipment and Weapon Gems you see the same idea happening there. Small Weapon Gems cost more than the Small Equipment Gems since having a better weapon than any other player is a bit better than having better clothing. By the way, Characters are different than Clothing. So, enjoy your new powerful weapons! Or Clothing. Whichever fits your fancy.

Time for me, I guess. As some people, I have two best memories, one from Build Mode and another from Play Mode.

Build :
My best moment was when I first started playing Brick-Force in Open Beta. My friend told me to go a room in Build mode, it was pìxel art map. Of course I was new, so I didn´t know anything about the bricks. I saw my friends flying and asked them how I could fly. They started trolling me that I had to use a certain "command(like /w)." I followed their directions and noticed that they were “laughing” at me. After they told me I had to buy the wings or the jetpack, I started griefing their pixel arts as revenge .
We started building and just..well, having fun! After the owner left, we stayed there for a while chatting and my friends telling me all about Brick-Force That was how I was introduced into the epic side of Brick-Force. Those memories made me love building maps and making friends while at it.

Play :
The first ever map that I played was the well-known map Kill Creek. I still remember how the players I played with were cooperative. Teamwork at its finest! They helped me kill the “Pros” and gave me strategic tips. From there on, I learned how to be the best player and never give up. That memory sure made me enjoy helping other player out. Whether is helping them kill another player, or just learn the advance ways of playing and staying positive even when loosing. I will never forget that, always stay postive. After a couple of days, I feel that nostalgia when I killed high-ranked people with the Black Widow. I felt excited, and rushed when I ended a match with a perfectly good K/D ratio. That was the only time I felt that, no other game has done, and that is why I love Brick-Force and all of its features.

Brick-Force; a game I will cherish even if it has problems. I´ll try and make the best out of me and others.

Hello Brick-Force Community,

As you know, this weekend is Easter weekend and there’s been a lot of speculation going around in the forum concerning the new, themed items.

As you might know, yesterday, 27 March, we had a 4-hour server maintenance during which we had initially planned to implement those new items. Unfortunately, we were confronted with several complications in the process. Ultimately, this is why we decided against implementing the new items and just do the maintenance which was necessary anyway in order to provide you with a smooth game experience.

We hope you believe us when we say that we didn’t make this decision lightly. The items exist and we would have loved to show them to you on time for Easter. However, besides the exciting new stuff, an update always also bears a lot of risks as it heavily interferes with server software. In the worst case, this could have led to massive server crashes which would have affected the entire Easter weekend. As we do not want to spoil your Brick-Force Easter, we decided to take the safe road and postpone the patch. We hope that you will understand.

Don’t worry though- we will not deprive you of the cool new items and probably push an update at some point after Easter. As Brick-Force is, by nature, a colorful and funny shooter, we are sure that the items will become popular even with Easter having passed.

The current Easter campaign doesn’t have anything to do with the holiday itself, but we are sure that you will enjoy the Space outfit and today’s “twice-the-Force-Points” campaign either way.

We wish you all a happy Easter with lots of chocolate and candy, many colorful Easter eggs and a lot of fun playing Brick-Force.

Thanks for your good wishes. I knew that the maintenance work will bring new things but for now they will not unlock. I thought that you update the maps and clans.

title: 20 Tips to Make You a Better Gamer.

posts.h:
Here is a list of SiNNiR's Tips n Tricks.

1. Know your map. Know the exits and entrances into your base. And on
average how fast people can get to the main areas of contact.

2. Know where the choke points are so that you can get multiple kills with a
single grenade. Or you can wait with your main weapon to get a few easy kills by people not expecting you to be there. Avoid going into the choke points yourself so you don't become grenade fodder.

3. Check both ways before crossing the street. Make sure you don't get shot in the back. This is why it's better to check the other side that you intend to go.

4. Use warpies so that you are harder to hit, and you have the speed to circle around the enemy while he/she is trying to shoot you.

5. It's a lot easier to make a person run out of ammo shooting at you. Make the enemy waste their ammo by only showing them your location, and when they are reloading go for the kill.

6. Try to estimate where the enemy is by throwing a grenade into the first POC is "point of contact". This way you can see if you wound someone by seeing their health bars, which last about 3 seconds. So now you know where the enemy is moving to.

7. Stay behind cover, whether it's a corner of a building, crates, or fellow teamates. It's always best to have some sort of a shield, even if it's a team member. Meat shields work too. Pop out from behind a corner just quick enough to see an enemy. Most likely they will shoot at you and waste their ammo. Listen for them to reload, then go in for the kill.

8. If you want to be a grenade ninja like me, practice cooking your grenade so that it explodes JUST before you turn the corner to finish off the enemy.

9. When you know an enemy is planting a bomb in difusion, throw a grenade towards the bomb site. Even if you don't hit the person, the majority of the people wills top planting and prepare for battle. This buys your team some more time to kill the bomb planter.

10. Bursting your fire is a lot more accurate at longer ranges than holding the trigger down and relying on spray and pray.

11. Aim for the neck or head for a quicker kill. Remember all guns have recoil. So the more you shoot, the higher the bullets rise. If you aim for the feet it take smuch longer to get more damage dealt, than if you would aim from the neck to the head. Total facial!

12. When you are in close range combat with an enemy, circle around them, people have a hard time aiming at a person who is circling around them.

13. Always try to get behind the enemy, they never seem to expect the "sneak attack". Most peopel are tend to worry about getting that kill, than they are about staying alive for some reason.

14. Don't stand still like a dummy when in a gun fight, move side to side, or in a circular pattern around your enemy. A moving target is always harder to hit.

15. Brick-Force gives you multiple weapons, You are not just stuck using your main weapon. When you are in close combat with an enemy, and you run out of ammo, switch to your pistol to finish the kill. It's faster to switch weapons than it is to reload your main weapon.

16. Don't always stay in the same areas, this isolates yourself and makes you an easy target after the enemy you killed respawns. He/she knows where you like to stay, and then can usually work their way behind you to get a sneak attack.

17. Choose your weapons according to the maps. There's no sense to have a sniper rifle on a small map. Choose accordingly.

18. If you want some fast kills and are not afraid to get killed. try and stay around the enemy spawning site. Or stay around the bomb sites, or flag site.

19. When you go up and down ladders, check all around the area you are about to enter before you enter it. Nothing sucks worse than going up a long ladder and getting shot in the back. Remember you can shoot when you are on a ladder.

20. You can actually hurd people into the direction you want them to go by throwing grenades in front of them. You don't always have to get a kill with a grenade. You can use grenades to control your enemies movements. God knows nobody likes becoming grenade fodder.

title: 7 Ways to reduce LAG and get better FPS

posts.h:
Hey guys and I girls, Benjodie here and I'm going to give you 20 tips to reduce Brick Force lag. One thing before we start, there is no server lag on Brick Force, its your INTERNET!!!! I think this should be in General Discussion just so most players see this and can use it.

#1 - Scan you PC, your PC may contain a virus even though you don't know it. There are many types of viruses that you can get on your PC, one type that will slow down your PC with hidden background applications that are running. These background programs will create a ton of lag, even thought you may think you don't have a virus you may or may not have one. Last week I scanned my PC, which contained about 13 small viruses. None of the virus's I had did anything harmful to my PC though. You can scan and remove viruses from you computer for free using malwarebytes free trial. http://www.malwarebytes.org/ The free trial works the same as the full version, only difference is full version gets flash scan and automatic updates. Once you download it simply install it, run it, scan it, bottom right of the window will show something thats says (Show Results) if you have a virus Click this and check the boxes on the left side of the window and hit the (Remove Selected) button.

#2 - This is a simple one but useful one. As some of you may know I have a maxed out PC, you can reduce lag by restarting your computer every 3-5 hour's. You computer has memory or RAM and your RAM can only be running so long until it runs out of memory. When your ram is running low on memory it will slowly create fps loss or lag on you PC. When you restart your PC it resets the RAM.

#3 - (Laptop only) This is choice to reduce lag only works for laptops only. This is simple but people tend to forget this a lot. When your laptop isn't plugged in it relies on its battery right? So when your laptop is not plugged in its starts to use it battery which puts stress on you laptop, and makes it harder to run because it knows it has a limited supply of battery before it dies out. So your laptop will take memory away from your RAM to save battery so the processor isn't going to drain the battery so fast (This is the same with gaming laptops). I know this because I have a gaming laptop and I run at a stable 100 FPS in a normal 8vs8 match when my laptop is plugged in. When it is unplugged I run at a unstable fps from 30-50 FPS.

#4 - This step may sound stupid but it works TRUST ME!!!! Your modem is what receives and send's data (WI-FI) which is how you connect to Brick Force. Your Modem should have a antenna on it and a lot of people have the antenna pointing down. Your modem will lose a lot of signal from this because if its pointing down the signal will only go to the bottom half and you could lose up to a good 5%-15% signal. Note - also keep your modem in a high spot and out of the sun this will prevent stress from high heat on it.

#5 - Brick Force and Youtube dont mix, what I mean by this every time you load a Youtube video it uses data from you internet or wi-fi. When you do this it will take a percentage of data from Brick Force. Example Only program open is Brick Force. Brick Force has all the Data in needs to run. Now you open up a Youtube video. Now Brick Force only has 80% Data and Youtube has 20% now. Since I have a really good internet I can play Brick Force and watch Youtube at the same time. However many people cannot do this.

#6 - Browser VS Client, you browser players will always have more lag then us client players. Browser players will experience more lag then client players because they are consistently receiving signals from the servers. When you are in the client you have every thing you need that's there right? When you have the browser open it keeps giving you signals on what's happening. So even thought it may take you a few minutes to hours to get the client I still suggest the client over browser.

#7 - Other devises, your family members may have cell phones, ipod's, ps3, xbox and other devises that can connect to WI-FI. When you are done with a devise I would suggest turning of the WI-FI on it. This is because every devise that is connected your WI-FI using up data and the data is shared trough out all the devises.

Don't worry that's not all the ways to reduce lag and increase fps. I have many more ways coming soon, I just don't feel like typing it all out right now. Thanks for reading this. - Benjodie.

title: Opinion: The best FP-only Main Weap and Light Weap now?

posts.h: I'm trying to get a replacement for my orange Beetle gun that expires in 3 days. I'm wondering what is considered the best for FP, and for what reason, now that more guns are available with FP in Season 3? I'm leaning towards Hornet, but I haven't had a chance to try any of the crossbow weapons.
posts.t: Opinion: The best FP-only Main Weap and Light Weap now?

posts.h:
I'd say the crossbows are for people with good aim. But that's my opinion.

As an Assault/Medium Rifle, the Hurricane and Thunder 37 are supreme. For me of course. If you have any problems handling the Thunder 47--try upgrading it a bit.

As a Sub-machine/Light Weapon, go for the Scorpion-Mosquito-Hornet. Usually the Hornet is favored, but the Mosquito can be just as good.

I'd say get the Crossbow's in the future. They might be buffed (Powered up) or nerfed (Powered down) later on. And you might be disappointed.

So I'd say, go for the Hurricane or the Mosquito. The Hurricane is better for most ranges, but the Mosquito can rip enemies apart in close and medium range.

What’s new in Brick-Force?

Season 3 will bring new outfits, weapons, and stylish medieval-themed items. It will also bring major changes to the game design. Brick-Points have been removed completely and old points have been added to your Force Points supply. The Map Manager has been revamped and there are several UI improvements. New Elite Gems have been added for every level range and a Force Point Charger has been introduced. There are many more changes, and you can experience them when Season 3 goes live.

Are there any new Functional Bricks?
We listened to community feedback and have added doors that can open and close, spiked floor traps, and portals that will give map builders an entirely new way to build maps. We have also added stylish glass windows and banners, for a truly epic feel.

What is different about the new Map Manager?

Our Map Manager will now display trending maps that are getting the most likes from the community. You can now add map descriptions to tell people what your map is about or even to write a backstory about it. Those playing your map can now comment to give you constructive feedback for improvement or just to say how much they enjoyed playing it.

Did somebody mention new Weapons?

“Our arrows will blot out the sun!” We added several fantastic crossbows, new fantasy melee weapons and all-new grenades/potion bombs. Prepare yourself for battle, grab your sword or axe and take part in epic medieval-style battles.

Are there any new Outfits?

Several new medieval costumes will be introduced with Season 3. Take on the role of a gallant knight, a cunning thief or a powerful mage. Rule your kingdom as the Brick-King or Princess and charge into battle.

What’s different about ranks?

You’ll now rank up faster, and with the revamped leveling system you’ll finally have a reason to level up. Ding! Weapons will now have level requirements and new play lobbies have been created to balance our new leveling systems. Of course, if you want to face off against opponents of all levels, there is the FUN channel.
Playing in level-specific channels rewards extra XP and FP, unlike the FUN channel. Once you enter a new level bracket, the previous bracket’s lobby will be closed off from play.
You may have noticed an increase from your former season 2 level. This is the new system in action. Your new level is based on what it would be if you had started leveling using the new leveling system from the beginning.

How does the new Map Rating System work?

Stardust has been removed and now you’ll simply have the option to evaluate a map. You may rate a map using “Thumbs Up” or “Thumbs Down”. More Up votes could place your map in the “What’s Hot” category, a place where popular new maps are showcased. The Thumbs Down option will reduce a map’s popularity and help alert the Infernum team about maps that shouldn’t be in circulation. Often these may be maps that are offensive, or that could be used to exploit gameplay. You’ll gain extra Force Points for evaluating maps, so be sure to take the time to support your map builders and let them know what you thought in the new comments box.

Brick Points have been removed? OMGWTFBBQ!

Brick Points have been added to your Force Point supply, so they haven’t been lost. Phew! You can now register your map with Force Points or Tokens. When your map is played by others you’ll earn additional Force Points. You might also want to set a map fee that can be between 0 - 1,000 Force Points.

Brick-Force is no longer Pay2Win?

In Season 3 there will be no shortcuts to glory, soldier! After much thought, we’ve decided to completely revamp our approach to the shop (now known as the Armory) and what players can do with their Tokens. Our goal is to make Brick-Force fairer, more challenging and much more fun. This is only the first phase of our new strategy. Together with you we will build a bricktastic future.

How have Item Upgrades changed?

The upgrade gems were also adapted to the level. As you level, you will unlock higher level stones. Along with our new gems, the upgrading system now has a fun, new UI. You can also merge upgraded items with non upgraded items of the same type, should your item have a time limit to it.

title: Just follow these simple steps—view XDCAM HD 422 1080/60i MXF files in VLC

posts.h:
I render out some XDCAM HD 422 1080/60i files from my Sony PMW-100. Although they can be edited and viewed in Sony Vegas fine, I have no reliable way to play back the raw MXF files on my PC. I have VLC, and the video looks pretty good, but the audio either plays at 4X speed, or simply stops after a few seconds, and if I click the timeline more than once, VLC crashes. Is that to say VLC doesn't like interlace XDCAM HD 422 MXF recordings, so does other player on my PC? I know that I can view and see MXF file with Sony XDCAM viewer, but MXF footage is not compatible format for most portable devices and can't be shared in YouTube. I need to transcode my 1080/60i MXF files.

I turned to look for some MXF viewer app and I got Aunsoft TransMXF Pro. This MXF viewer is versatile, converting and transcoding MXF files to multi-track video, HD video, MOV, MP4, MKV, AVI, FLV, WMV, MPG, etc for playing on PC and portable devices. In order to view XDCAM 422 MXF files in VLC, I deinterlance and transcode 1080/60i MXF to DivX AVI. Here I'd like to share my experience.

Step1. Accurately load MXF to TransMXF Pro

Click "add video" or "add folder" to load MXF file. I dragged several MXF clips to it directly to do batch conversion.

In this step, you may encounter that XDCAM HD MXF with just video but no audio. A suggestion is to click "add folder" to load the entire MXF whole structure folder to avoid of missing audio caused by metadata loss. Then, you can play raw MXF files in the preview window with both audio and video. Meanwhile, the output encoded AVI files will also be with sound.

Snapshot function seems pretty good when preview MXF file.



Step 2: Click the format bar and select "HD Video -> DivX HD Video (*.avi)" for VLC

Click Format bar to choose output format and you can choose MP4, AVI, MKV or other common formats. Here I choose "HD Video -> DivX HD Video (*.avi)", which is supported by nearly all player and portable devices.
I directly enter Avid in the search bar, even faster. The user-friendly format bar of TransMXF Pro will take you less than 30 seconds to select format in this step.



Step3. Deinterlace XDCAM HD422 1080/60i MXF video

Click “Editor” button and then click "Effect". Tick the checkbox of "Deinterlacing" to deinterlance XDCAM HD422 MXF video. Then the AVI generated from raw MXF files will be played flawlessly in VLC. Here you are allowed to crop unwanted video parts, trim video length and add some special effects. You can preview the raw MXF and output AVI simultaneously here.



Step4. Click convert button in the main interface to transcode MXF to AVI for VLC

TransMXF Pro will run conversion at super fast speed. Not for a while, I got generated DivX HD AVI with perfect video and audio synchronization. And with just a click on "Open output folder", I quickly located the output file.

If you look for MXF viewer app to simply view XDCAM MXF files, or a reliable way to play back the raw MXF files on my PC, Aunsoft TransMXF Pro is professional MXF viewer app to play and see MXF file on PC media player.

how does the auto reload action item work?
Sorry to steal your glory here Dax, but I'll answer this one. I am sure you'll get more traffic in the future.

How auto reload is used

  1. ​Go to 'My Items'
  2. You will see 4 little buttons along the bottom. "Allocate items to loadout" , "Clear Expired items" , unequip all" and "merge". Click on 'Allocate items to loadout'
  3. Along the side of the popup you will see 2 buttons. "Weapons" and "Action Panel". Click on 'Action Panel'
  4. Next, find your auto reload, click it then drag it to one of the 5 slots, (10 if you have a premium account).
There you have it. Auto reload.

Originally Posted by Kagome0615
"Why isn't our inventory from server we're playing aren't the same at the different server?"
The data related to your personal account based on what server you have selected is not the same saved data from server to server as you know. To better manage accounts and the stored information related to what server you are playing on it was optimal to keep the related information to that server on that server. This reduces lag and the amount of time that is needed to connect to the server by playing a server that is closer to your location and keeping all information related close at hand. I also agree it would be nice if the data was shared and the same on both servers but it just is not possible at this time unfortunately. However we are looking into a solution or a means to better this, perhaps in the future we will see transfers possible but currently we are unable to do this.

title: Season 4 - Part 2: Feedback for your Feedback

posts.h:
Dear Brick-Forcers,

After the last, difficult patch, I’d like to explain our decisions and thought process in a bit more detail. With the second downtime this past Friday, we had to correct three errors which were hotly discussed here, and rightly so. After the update, all weapons now feature the correct stats again, there are Force Points in all channels except for the Fun Channel (more on that below), and the prices of the upgrade gems have been corrected.

Force Points removed from the Fun Channel:

There are no longer Force Points in the Fun Channel. This change was intended to encourage players to join the channels intended for their level. There, you’ll get more XP and FP, plus protection for players who are not that advanced in the game. This week, we also plan to deliver another function that was actually intended for the last patch and that we consider essential:

The channels will have weapon star restrictions. This is what that will look like, as described in the patchnotes:
- Beginner Channel: up to 3-star weapons
- Medium Channel: up to 4-star weapons
- Veteran / Fun Channels: all weapons allowed

That means it will no longer be possible to use 5-star weapons in the Beginner Channel. Our aim here is to make for fairer and thus more fun gameplay in all channels, especially the Beginner and Medium Channels.
In addition, we will add new maps to the official channels each Monday, making Brick-Force’s special map diversity more visible. That of course includes the Map of the Week and any contest winners. So the selection will grow from week to week.

New Prices and Token Packages:

We have made changes to the Token packages and lowered shop prices accordingly. All in all, this makes the shop more affordable and much more transparent than before the update. Now, a light 5-star weapon always costs 1,600 Tokens. Costumes have become significantly more affordable. Upgrade gems now have different prices according to level: Small and Medium Weapon Gems are cheaper, while the large ones are somewhat more expensive. For the costumes, the small ones are cheaper, the medium ones are about the same, and the larger ones more expensive.
I’d like to illustrate how you are now getting a better deal with a few examples:

Let’s say someone buys 2,500 Tokens in the old system, before the update. Then they buy the Hornet 96 for the old price of 1,999 Tokens, so they’ve got 501 Tokens left.

After last week’s price update, the player receives only 2,140 Tokens for the same amount of money. But they get the Hornet for the lower price of 1,600 Tokens and still have 540 Tokens left over, which they can use, for example, to buy 10 Small Elite Gems (400 Tokens). The bottom line is you get more for your money, despite receiving fewer Tokens.

This is even more apparent with the outfits. The Fire Dragon Jacket was 1,899 Tokens, now only 900. Remainder with the old Token package: 601. Remainder with the new Token package: 1,240. In the old system, you could only have afforded 15 elite gems after that. But with the 1,240 Tokens in the new system, you can get 10 Small, 10 Medium, and 10 Large Elite Gems. That’s almost enough to fully upgrade the item.

Don’t forget that normal gems for Force Points are now cheaper and can replace elite gems.

As the above examples have hopefully shown, the prices are now lower overall. There are also a lot more items available for Force Points now. Based on your feedback, we also decided to make three more weapons available for Force Points: the Snake, the Orion, and the Beacon.

Further Steps

There are still a few more changes to come as part of Season 4. Unfortunately, the web player is still an issue for us, and the problem of disruptive messages with towers and weapon pick-ups is already being worked on by our developer. More information on further updates, contests, and much more will follow soon.
Until then, I wish you all a lot of fun in-game.

Maybe we’ll run into each other.

Best Regards,

Henning
