I am really bored over the community's constant arguing over the game, in both EU and US servers.

I earned my way through this game, though I may be sometimes ignorant of Support or how the Moderators manage the game, I understand why Infernum does this and will never change its direction. Reason? Simply money.

You, the players are buying into their sales, because you are lured by the eye-candy weapons and stats that dominate foes. Yet you continue to buy into the sales. Now you may not be the payers who buy these things, you most likely have a legitimate argument over this issue. However, the people who buy into this and start ranting over this, are hypocritical over this, I do not fall into this category, but with a few exceptions, from joking around and someone takes it seriously to an out of context phrase that people think I am serious.

Regardless, this game is not a mess, it is not broken, it is just the way the community buys into the economy. Again, we get this constant flow of sales, because at this point they know you will buy tokens on weekends and potentially on certain days when they sell a really cool item for one day in the weekday.

These are all fixed and firm, will not budge unless the majority of the community acts upon it where they do not buy anything from sales. Consequently, it causes problems for Infernum's funds if the community does so.

So how does a community try to fix this? Simply push Infernum to not make buffs on new weapons? More different methods of attacking? These attempts have been done and even Infernum claimed this, problem is that it did not work. They did honestly try to prevent it, but the money flow did not continue because you were not lured into buying their items. I noticed this, but then I found out they started buffing outfits, and notice they were earning more because they were buffed.

So again, it is the community, yes you guys, the guys who created the Brick-Force community, are causing this. Although, it is also Infernum's fault for not trying to make weapons or items appetizing for players to buy while they don't cause much of a imbalance of gameplay.

Solution to this problem? The marketing is great, the only issue is that the increase of the versions of weapons are too high, in fact they should balance and counter different versions of each other, similar to the versions of the Beetle Series where they have different stats that are useful in different ways.

Outfits already have this method, but do not really balance as much, in fact nothing really makes them pop out. Even the Close Beta Helm has not gained a buff, just random event outfits have gain buffs. Currently Infernum is working that out.

Back onto the Weapon issue, basically classified weapons such as "Rare" or "Golden" have an overall stat boost by 3 points, 3 points don't seem much, but have a massive impact in gameplay, it creates a faster time to KO a player than a regular maxed version of the gun. [Example: Beacon and Beacon Rare] Though there is Radiant Beacon, it is one of the balanced versions as said before, but when the Beacon Rare came out, it is one of many examples of guns that are the same but with a higher level of stats.

To conclude this, the community is majorly at fault at 70%, where as Infernum is less than 30% at fault, it isn't really their fault for doing this, people who play this buy only because of the incentive and the stats of items to dominate people faster, which isn't fair on either side.

My solution to all of this is bare-bones mode. Simply put; this would be a feature that game hosts could enable (like weapon dropping) that would disable all stat upgrades on anything that effects the gameplay, i.e armor and weapon damage. A rare spider 36 would still be useable, but it would function akin to a standard spider 36 with no stat upgrades. Thus everyone keeps their paid eye candy, everyone still gets to use their upgrades outside of the mode, but those with a preference to play a more fair and balanced game where anyone has a chance would have an option to host games according to our preference. I feel this would lead to players staying for longer as they would no longer be required to get smurfed continuously in a relentless grind to achieve some sort of capable firearm and significant hp boost. Instead they would have a mode where they could always play fairly with their friends and others, which would also make it easier for me to introduce new players to the game.

I am someone who buys gear, uses gems etc because I like the game, and I want the means to be able to keep playing the game at the same level as someone who's parents buy them those armor gems, or those rare op weapons. Unless you want to sacrifice your job, your life in general, and invest all your time into Brick-Force and playing countless matches where you get stomped by people with token gear over and over again, chances are your only way to stand much of a chance past beginner is to pay. Not to mention so much of the gear can only be accessed by tokens, whilst other gear only has temporary options for force points. If you truly did purely grind up to a point of being a capable adversary against 240hp players with rare weapons then you need to understand something; not everyone has your patience, or your time.

Lastly, the blame rests on Infernum. People will buy into these P2W systems, just as people will buy into games like TF2, a F2P FPS competitor that has a roughly $50,000,000 economy based on purely cosmetic items alone. In short, there's no one way to create a F2P model in a shooter, and the devs for Brick-Force simply chose a method that is going to draw in the money of those who want to feel power over others. People want that sense of power over other people, that's where the gratification comes from, and paying for power is a simple means to achieve it. A demographic will always exist to buy into this sort of F2P model at the expense of the quality of the game experience for everyone else, and the developers chose to appeal to that demographic, make no mistake.

Bare-Bones Mode = Less incentive to purchase tokens because players can't handle weapons so they will make it difficult to use items they bought and upgraded.

Also, you do realize I can manage to defeat players with at least 50 armor, it isn't hard. You just have to be more cautious as the game is already unstable, plus its meant to be a progressive game. Where you earn to the point of becoming unstoppable.

Also about TF2's economy, so what if it's a 50M$ Economy? Why are you implying its a competitor? It's a community-driven economy. It didn't have to be 50M$ but it sort of happened. Why are you implying that TF2 is a F2P game that you have to spend for quality? On that game it's for fun or just to trade. It's optional to buy, but you can earn over a 1000$+ in a month if you know the trading methods.

Anyways B-F is not a competitor in anyway to TF2. TF2 is a juggernaut for Steam. B-F has a chance to be a juggernaut in Unity Games and Kongregate.

posts.h:
Please submit all of the stories here. Thanks Brick-Forcers.
ONLY SUBMISSIONS HERE. This is not a question thread nor a conversation thread. If you have questions message me.

One spooky dark night, a Brick-Force soldier and his soldier friends were out camping in the middle of the Brick forest. They were sitting on logs around their campfire, telling spooky stories and eating blocky s'mores.

"...And so, after sometime of being scared in his tent, the terrified camper decided to finally take a look outside to see what he had been hearing. Right as he left the tent, it started raining and storming." Said one soldier, telling one of his spooky stories from his book of Creepy Tales that he bought a few days ago, from a creepy old man at his local library.

Just as he finished his sentence, the fire turned an eerie shade of green, and appeared to have a ghostly face. The face in the fire was trying to warn them of something, but was put out by a sudden downpour of rain. Then as thunder struck a nearby tree, the soldiers decided they would spend the rest of the night in the tent. As they entered the tent, they lit a candle that they bought from the Season 3 medieval brick pack. And right as they lit the candle, they saw something horrible -- a shadowy figure with purple mean-looking eyes in their tent. Right as they all got a frightened look on their face, the figure formed a small black mist and quickly flew out of the tent. Scared like heck, they all decided it was not safe outside and they should stay in the tent until they can reach help somehow. One of the soldiers got out his phone and started to call the police, when he lost connection. Being the bravest of the soldiers, he decided he would go out and try to find a signal. He then left the tent. The other soldiers decided they could pass the time by continuing the story.

"The camper was about to go back in his tent when he realized a pair of purple eyes in the bushes. The bushes began to shake, and then the purple eyes leapt out of the bushes, revealing a shadowy body!"

They all looked at each other, shaking from what the soldier had just read. Soon after, the soldiers all heard a spine-chilling shriek from outside. It sounded like the soldier that left to look for a phone signal! The soldiers peaked outside, and saw the soldier standing before them -- except something was wrong. Very, very wrong. He was pale as can be, and wasn't blinking. Then his lifeless body fell over, revealing the shadowy purple-eyed figure they had seen before and heard about in the scary story.

***

The Brick Town News Team was interviewing a soldier that lost his whole team 3 weeks ago on halloween night, while camping in the Brick forest. He was telling about his frightening story about that night in the woods.

"Those eyes, those horrible purple eyes!" He said. "Those awful eyes were the last thing I saw that night. I woke up the next morning in the middle of a trashed campsite that was once ours. The tent was on fire, but the fire was purple and was not put out from the night's storm. The campfire had been lit, except bones replaced what was once timber. The fire was green, except now instead of one face, there was the face that we saw trying to warn us before, along with the faces of my whole team. It took me 6 days to get out of that forest, well, with that horrible thing slowly chasing me. I could not stop to sleep, not to eat. I thought, 'Why did that thing spare me?' That whole time I was escaping, I was thinking about the whole experience, putting all the pieces together. It came to me that whoever wrote that story in the Creepy Tales book must've been the victim, and the victim's face was the one we saw in the green campfire trying to warn us. This made me think I was in bigger danger than I had ever thought."

The interview went viral to the whole Brick world. Reporters would be outside the doors and windows of his house for days at a time, camping in his front lawn just to get coverage for his one story, while he sit inside his house thinking about the haunting experience of 3 weeks ago.

***

The Brick Town News Team, in association with the Brick Town P.D., were now investigating the murder of the soldier that lost his whole team one month ago, on halloween night while camping in the Brick forest. His last words were written on paper, in the book of Creepy Tales, and his bones were found blazing in the green campfire along with the rest of his team's and the original victim's. The case was never solved, and to this day the book of Creepy Tales has never been checked out again... until next halloween, anyway.

***

THE END. Thank you for reading!

When the night arrived a strange feeling came over me. Was it a shiver? It could have just been the cold breeze. Yeah that's what it was!Right? I hugged
bollock close to me incase someone jumped out, they would drop dead straight away. That's how good I am. I carried on going, walking towards my next
location, hoping that i would be able to kill someone. I literally loved it so much, the thrill of getting to shoot someone just gave me the adrenaline
i needed to carry on. It has become such a natural thing, to just kill someone, it felt like i was really doing it. Just as i was thinking my thoughts
were rudely interupted by the sound of a branch breaking. My head quickly jerked to where the sound had come from and i started taking slow steps towards
the tree. As i reached it there was nothing, must have been just the wind, just as the thought crossed my mind another there was another sound just like
the one before. Okay thats it. That is definetely not the wind, someone is there. I began to slowly run towards the source of sound. Still nothing. I
climbed a tree for better view but nothing could be seen over the mist that suddnely took over. What? Where did this come from? As a went around the tree
rabbed my leg, it was cold and dry. It felt like a hand but when i looked down it was far off than a hand. It was a tree branch, and it moved all by
itself. What the .. ? How could this be possible and more importantly how do i kill it? This was a new challenge and i was more than prepared to
accept it. I grabbed my Archer's Axe and cut the branch that was wrapped around my leg. To show my victory i smirked and took a step forward but to my
dissapointment i couldn'd take another step. The tree branch that i had just cut grew back and even longer and it was now wrapped around my leg again.
Before i could swing for it again a root came out of the ground and grabbed my hand squeezing it so hard that i was no longer able to control my hand
anymore. The Archer's Axe fell out of my hand and all i could do was follow it with my eyes. Any chance of me surving was ruined. I KNEW that this was it.
I wasn't going to die from a bullet or a zombie, i was going to die from the .. ground? Before i knew it i was wrapped in roots and was being lowered
closer and closer to the ground. I know that sometimes i wish the grown swollows me alive but i didn't actually mean it. Why does the worse wishes have
to happen to me? I felt my lower body sink into the dirty ground and before i knew it my head was the only thing left to go. I took a deep breath and
braced myself for what was to come. I am being taken to the land of the truly dead.
i open my eyes and see that i am back in the battle field surrounded by all of my team mates. I look around making sure that i wasn't dreaming. I must
have been respawned but the weird thing was that i had never seen the ground do that before. It must be something new. Probably the new update but all i
know is that this game has taken me to a new level.

The Closet

It was late at night and i was all alone. All by myself in this mansion my family calls home. Sitting cross-legged on my bed staring at my book i hear the creak of
my closet door as if someone is slowly opening it. I look up at it and see that it is now ajar. My heart quickens and breathing deepens. I stare at the door as if it
will go back to normall in a bit. I am definetly sure that i left the door close, it must have just opened by itself, maybe the door handle wasn't put up all the way
and the weight had finally won over which is why the door opened. Yeah that's it. I turn back to my book and after a page of the interesting story i am reading i hear
creak again. My head bolts up so quick that i hear it click under the sudden movement. Ouch. My eyes lock on the door and see that it has opened even more, Oh God.
This is getting really strange however even though my mind is screaming at me to run and get as far away from the door as i could my body tells me otherwise. There's
the tiny little curious voice that tells me to go and see what it is. I wish i wasn't alone. I start to slowly walk towards the door, it feels like 15 minutes have
passed by the time i had gotten off the bed, my eyes never leaving that door. I am now stood up and slowly taking a step towards the closet. Just as i'm about to place
my foot down i hear something fall against the floor from another room, my head involuntary looks towards my bedroom door as if i could see through it and see where the
sound has come from. It sounded like a pan falling on the kitchen floor. I put that at the back of my head as i look back to my closet door and gasp. The door has
opened a little more and i can now see part of my favourite coat. I take a few more slow steps as my mind is going overdrive with thoughts. My heart feels like it's
going to explode and i feel like there isn't enough air in this room. I am now almost by the door, arm lenght away from it. I slowly reach to grab the handle and once
i do i brace myself for the worst. I swing the door open. Nothing, nothing but clothes. I turn the light on in the closet to make sure that nothing is hiding in the
dark and i give a breath of relief as nothing is there. But then again, what opened the door? I turn around and come face to face with the scariest thing i have ever
seen. I scream loud, hoping someone would hear me. The evil creature just smiles at me, showing me its black teeth, nothing in it's features shows me any trace of
goodness. The eyes, they are the worst part, so dark they are almost black, black and empty eyes, locked to mine. I try to look further but there is no light in them,
no hope. I look down, trying to fully see this creature but i find that it has no legs, its long black gown flowing mid-air. Is this a ghost? An evil ghost? I take a
step back and the thing smiles, and evil smile that will haunt me for the rest of my life. The thing reaches for something in its gown and when it takes out what it
was looking for my eyes widen and i scream knowing what is coming next. The sharp and long black blade is pushed through me within seconds leaving me no time to scream.
The pain is so unbearable that i can't feel my body anymore and i feel my body starting to shut down as if the blade held black poison which is now slowly spreading
throughout my entire body.
I wake up screaming, sweat running down my face and the blanket now on the floor. I hug my legs closer to my body and look around the room in panic as if this really
just happened. It was just a nightmare, just a nightmare. My heartbeat slowly goes to normal and i relax.
After and hour i decide to go back to bed and as i'm about to fall asleep i hear the creak of my closet door.

It was a late night, and all of the noobs were having fun in SniperHill. Suddenly a message appeared in the bottom-left corner of the screen, [System][OneXz] has joined the room.

The End

My sworn brother Robin and I live in the Brick Plateau. We're both 16 and my dad
sent us two packages for our birthday. He works for the Brick-Force Hierarchy, a company
dedicated to killing the zombies roaming the land. Robin and I are opening our packages.
He gets a Spider 36 - a high-ranking weapon in the Hierarchy. I get a sniper rifle that is colored black and has the word "SOON" carved on it.
"You think we're going to get raided tonight?" Robin asks.
"I hope not, but at least we have weapons."
"I guess so."
Just then, we hear scratching.
"Zombies!" Robin yells. "Quick, get some ammo and let's drive them out!"
Robin I run to our kitchen where we hide ammo behind the fridge. Once our new guns
are loaded, Robin heads to the front door while I cover the back door. After seconds of
silence the first zombie bursts through the door, scattering wooden shards everywhere.
I quickly shoot it with my sniper, but the imbecile seems unfazed. I hear Robin
bellow in pain as one of the zombies bites him, but there's no time to help. I barely
jump out of the way as my enemy swipes at me. Taking out my Falcon 18, I kill the thing.
I peek out the door. Outside, there are more zombies charging the house. But one
of them stands out - he looks just like my father.
Robin is done with his side of the horde - there were only 5. He runs over and his
skin turns ghost white when he sees the zombie that looks like my father. I am equally
mortified, but I stomach it and start shooting the massive group. A few of them go down in
one shot, but the rest march forward. I begin to feel a little uneasiness.
We could do nothing to hold them back and run into the house as fast as we could.
Inside, some of the zombies throw acid at us - fluids that run in their blood. It hits us
both and we cry out as our skin burns.
"Gross."
We've lost track of the zombies. Our house is now a minefield of them.
I step toward the TV and urge Robin to follow. He does, but I hear a little growling under his
breath. 3 of the dead leap out. We're able to finish them off, but my right arm hurts too much to use.
By now, there should only be around 10 left. I check the
couch while Robin limps toward the bathroom. He's getting slower and slower. 2 zombies appear.
I shoot them with my left hand, which violently snaps back after a few shots. They
manage to stab me in the stomach with their claws. I try not to look at the damage
and finally kill both of them with the Falcon 18. I notice my blood from the wounds is blue.
A zombie tackles me from the chandelier and bites my neck. Pain sears into
my nervous system and my vision turns a little green. Robin must not be taking his bite well.
By now, my Falcon 18 has run out of ammo. However, I still finish the job with my rifle.
I head up the stairs to find 3 zombies staring at me. Only this time, a dark aura
surrounds them and they're holding what I can only assume are pitchforks.
The deadly trio begin their attack. At this point my head is spinning and my right arm is
emanating the same aura as the zombies. Slamming into one of them, their shield dissipates
immediately. The other two begin to murmur.
"nO cHaNcE aGaInSt DeAtH iTsElF."
"Quiet," I shout as a sniper bullet finds its way through the zombie's head. I whack the
last one standing with my arm and finish it.
"Robin!" I call as I run toward the bathroom. I find him crouching with his back
turned from me. Around him are the remaining zombies. They have all been incapacitated.
"You OK, Robin?
There's no response as he rises. It's then that I notice his skin is green. Robin whips around.
He's been fully infected.
"KILL!"
I shoot his legs. They go down and so does Robin.
"CRUSH!" He tries to snag my left ankle. He's successful and squeezes hard.
I don't feel any pain, but I notice my body is now covered in dark energy.
"DESTROY." Suddenly, all life exits from Robin's body and his dark spirit flies toward me.
Bullets still hit him and his spirit reenters his body. Robin crumples, shaking. I know what I must do.
If I don't kill Robin, he could infect soldiers and create chaos.
"I'm sorry. Thanks for all the good times." I whisper as I pull the trigger.
He turns limp for a second. Then, his spirit accelerates out the window. Robin screams,
"YOU DIE. HAHEHEHE!" I ponder his words for a moment.
Suddnely, my vision begins to fade as the world around me disappears. I come to my senses to see
a zombified version of my father. I didn't see him after I looked out the door. He
must have been infected.
"Death takes us all...Do not evade the inevitable," he remarks. Then, he grabs me.
Everything turns blood red and I find my skin turning into that of a zombie.
"Grr...GRRROOOWWWAAAHHH!"

posts.h: I think the best way to figure it out if they do this to contact the support

After what Jakyo have told me, I was completely shock and utterly speechless, the bankrupt in the game now explains a lot of things. You can view Infernum Production reply here: http://www.brick-force.com/forum/sho...n-Headquarters

This kind of bankrupt is no ordinary bankrupt, the publisher is well protected, it's an "ag" company which means it 's interest are shared amongst many. However, it's developer: EXE Games is completely terminated. And when I say "terminated" I mean it doesn't even exist anymore. If you try to search up "EXE Games" or "EXE Games Brick-Force" you wouldn't get an reliable result. No official site, no nothing, the developer is completely gone. Not only have brick-force gone bankrupt but got it's developer disappear from the net. Something bad has happened to EXE games, and it's not normal either

After doing further research, I've found out that the game is suppose to be dead right now, in fact it should've been removed. It has no official license, no developer to update the game, and there are no official administrators. In fact, there is no one working for Infernum production and EXE games is dead.

This means that no matter how many times your try to contact with Infernum Production, you will get no reply regardless if it's just something small like a ticket or a question. It also means that we don't know where the money we give is going to, if I am correct, the money they have lost since the incident should've exceed that amount already, it is recovered from it's incident, but it's not getting back to it's shape.

This brings us to one question: "How is the game alive when litterly no one is leading it?", it's just hanging there in the net.

For those of you guys who say we should wait, well you are wrong, waiting is useless and I'm tired of waiting, the game is not going to revive itself, we will have to find out the truth about what happened that cause the game to die. No updates will be available, nothing new will be available unless we do something about it

Sorry for such a hazy post, I'm up late posting this, I could've present my findings much more better. I'll update this post in a day or so with additional information. For now, this is what you need to know.

Attention Brick-Forcers!
I am Dr. Brickula! I am calling upon all of you to build me something. I am sick of looking at my old lair. I need something new. Here is exactly what I am looking for:


Building Requirements:
• I need detail in the building. I tend to get bored with all black, all purple, all gray. I need something to spice it up a little.
• The floor plan needs to be balanced and easy to maneuver. I am clumsy and there is nothing more I hate than running into my paintings on the walls.
• I need Team Death Match mode for my guests to play. Oh how I enjoy some team death match
• I need Death Match mode for my guest as well. I enjoy seeing friends fight to the bitter end of the match.
• My castle needs Capture the Flag since I enjoy seeing my guests run around with a flag which has basically just put a big target on their heads.
• The map needs to be fun in all of these modes.
• You can add Diffusion mode if you do choose. It isn’t needed, but it will net you some bonus points.

Your build will be scored in the specific areas I mentioned above.

Category Points
Detail ? / 20 Points
Balance ? / 20 points
TDM Mode ? / 2 Points
DM Mode ? / 2 Points
CTF Mode ? / 2 Points
Diffusion Mode ? / 3 Points
Fun Factor ? / 10 Points
Bonus Points ? / 6 Points
Total: ? / 65 Points



Contest Rules:

Map Rules:

1. The map must consist of at least 15,000 bricks.
2. The map must be playable.
3. The map must be balanced and fair.
4. The map must be submitted by its builder.
5. The map must be new, i.e. it must be registered during the contest period. Existing maps which are reregistered will not be eligible.
6. The map must be completed and registered before submission.

Submission Rules:

7. Your submission post must include the name of the map. Be careful to avoid typos because the map cannot be evaluated if the name is not correct.
8. You must provide the following map details: number of bricks and supported game modes.
9. Screenshots of the map are preferred but not required unless additional rules specify otherwise.

Rules of Conduct:

10. Posting offensive or discriminatory content or symbols is strictly prohibited.
11. Remakes of maps by other players or from other games will not be considered – we want to judge your own creativity, not your ability to copy the work of others.
12. There will be consequences if anyone submits someone else’s work as their own.




Prizes
1st Place:
  • x1 Permanent Golden Rare (Rattler 42 or Beetle1S)
  • x1 Additional Map Slot
2nd Place:
  • x1 20,000 FP Charger
  • x1 10 Pick N’ Win Coin Charger
3rd Place:
  • x1 10,000 FP Charger
  • x10 Pick N' Win Coin Charger
If you have any questions about this contest or its conditions please post them on this thread.

To submit your map please post on this thread: CLICK HERE TO SUBMIT!​
Deadline: May 31st, 2016

Best Regards,
The Brick-Force Community Team

I've got a few tactics to counter cyberbully, however, these tactics are not ways of cyber bully, instead it's reverse psychology, and useful to know.

1) If the person abusing you is in your team, tell him:

. He cannot co-operate with a team
. He's letting his team down
. He doesn't care and can't even respect his own teammate and therefore makes him the bad person here (call him a noob if he calls you a noob).
This would make him feel bad about himself and amazingly has some really good effects on players. I've tried this before and manage to neutralize many people behavior

2) Let out your rage, cyberbully loves it when you rage at them, but I'm not talking about the rage you see from a 12 year old kid. I'm talking you should rage emotionally and really express your feelings about there words towards you.
This may not seem much, and would give the cyberbully the upper hand, here is the example:

Cyberbully guy: You suk boi, can't even scope

Victim: You can't even respect players don't you?, I bet you are feeling proud about this sht, making other people rage huh?

At this point, you have the upper hand and could pretty much improvise the rest of your argument from here

3) Act tough back, not in an offensive way, but in an adult-style way. Here is an example:

Cyber Bully: Do you not know how to use a gun?

Victim: Do you not know how to respect others?, you must be in your early youth then.

Cyber Bully: What is youth?

Victim: Something you'll learn if you put more into education and learning instead of gaming.

You can improvise form this point on, that example is my latest cyber bully experience, he apologized to me at the end

To summaries this up, think outside the box, think about why are they bullying you? and use this reason to counter their words and give them a good teaching in your own ways like I've just did. If all things don't go well, you can use the classic way and just ignore and report him.

posts.t: [Contest] Tell us the scariest story of all times! 2016

posts.h:
It was last night, at around, 1:30am. I always liked to work on homework as late as could, because I liked to put off work until the the last possible moment, and the professor put the due date at 3am. I was tired too, like anyone who studied all day, but it was my choosing and I had to live with it. I had a dog too, and her name was Bella. She was a beautiful golden lab, and with me living alone, she kept me company and was well behaved. She was sleeping at my feet when I finally turned the test in, and had to let her out to go to the bathroom before she goes to bed. So I made her go outside, even if she didn’t want too because she just woke up and it was raining hard.
While she was outside, I went back to my room to brush my teeth and change. I usually got hot when I slept, so changing just just meant putting on a pair of sweatpants to walk to let Bella in, and sleeping in nothing but my underwear. After I brushed my teeth, I walked back to the door to let Bella in. But as I was walking to the door, I heard her scratching and howling at the door. Sensing something was wrong, I jogged over and opened the door to find the absolute worst thing I have ever seen. My dog was unrecognizable. Beaten and mutilated beyond recognition, was my dog, lying dead at my doorstep. At this, I violently threw up some of the Cheerios I ate earlier. My mistake was looking around to see who, or what, did this to my dog, and unfortunately I saw something. Up, at the top of my driveway, was a shadowed figure, only visible by the dim streetlight.
My fear turned to rage as it slowly began to make its way down my driveway. I ran to the kitchen and got my handgun, assuming the kitchen would be the best place for self-defense because it had a clear view of the front door.
After waiting anxiously for what felt like an eternity, I decided to approach the door. But just as I made my way to the door, it exploded off of it’s hinges, flying through the house and into the TV. I yelped at this, but froze in terror at what welcomed me. Coming through the singed doorway was a dark figure.
The thing was the spawn of nightmares. He was completely naked and was as muscular as an ox. He was completely black, and his skin looked like murky, thick mix of black sludge and tar. He was covered in deep crimson tattoos, which looked more like brands and they were in a language foreign to me. He had heavy, clawed feet and his hands were the same. But the most terrifying part about him, was his face. His face, if you could even call it that, was slick, black liquid. His mouth, stretched from ear to ear and his lips, were just pulpy, chewed up mix that was constantly dripping after involuntary chewing to due the the rows of plaque and blood covered needles he called teeth. And on top of his head, he had horns, like those of a baby goat.
It stared at me dead in the eye, and dropped my chewed up dog, which I didn’t even notice he had when he came in. In a swift act of bravery, I aimed my gun and hit him right in the forehead. He let out the loudest and most petrifying screech I had ever heard. I covered my ears in pain. His black tar like body let out a thick, gulpy spray of the black oil mixture. Some of it landed on me and it burned my skin. But not only a few second after the scream, he looked at me again, and the bullet hole I just shot him in, disappeared as the bullet, tinkled to the ground. I yelled and urinated my pants after overwhelming terror took over. The demon, took out a ferocious looking battle axe, supposedly out of thin air, and smashed my side with it. My right arm broke, as did my ribs with a sickening crunch. I screamed as he grabbed my legs and took me to the basement.
I must have blacked out, either due to loss of blood or my head hitting the basement steps, because when I woke up, I was having awful visions and imagined seeing things in the dark. It hurt too much to move and I threw up the rest of my small dinner, due to the pain. I remember praying and looking at the old picture I never hung up of the crucifixion that was in my basement. It was my grandma's old house, and she been the one to led me to Christianity. After what felt like hours, and on cue with my praying, the creature returned.
The beast, looked different now. His his horns, were now those of a massive ram. His muscles had doubled in size, and he now had two glowing, blood red eyes that seemed to be bleeding down his black face. His presence, made the room feel evil; demented, and it felt like hell on earth.
Two things happened in my last moment on earth. The demon raised his ax and said the most terrifying thing, the only thing I didn’t need to hear in this moment of sheer fear and horror. I screamed, for I didn’t know what would happen next. As he flexed his muscles before bring down the heavy ax, before the sickening crunch and a lifeless body toppling to the floor, it said 3 words.
“God is Dead”

970 words

It was that night in the Mr. Elec's Blue Box Alliance base, a group of soldiers were patrolling and keeps an eye out for intruders. There was Dave, and the other two who were talking and telling stories about the history of the Blue Box Alliance.

"Did you know? I heard that there was a little girl in white dress dancing and running around this place again. Creepy huh?” says the patrolling soldier #5721 as the soldier #5723 nods with a chill down on his spine.

Clearly Dave may believe it's true but he decided to forget about it because he needs to be focused. But as time passes by, a large blue moon was shining above the base. Then, Dave said, "I will rely on you two to check on your checkpoint. I will be watching on my checkpoint." The other soldiers nodded as they then head towards their checkpoint until they're no longer at Dave's sight.

Dave began patrolling on the checkpoint he’s suppose to be at and where he always guard on: “The Warehouse.” Dave feel anxious and curious about what’s inside because nobody knows what’s inside. The curiosity drives him insane as he check around to see if nobody’s looking and slowly opens the door of the warehouse and enters quietly.

As he was about to turn on the flashlight, he suddenly saw a giant shadowy figure running towards him. He panicked as he aims his flashlight towards it, it was just a blanket, covering the top of some kind of a coffin covered in top. “What’s this coffin?” He wonders. He pulls out his Poker 7 and slowly tore off the tape and slowly opens the coffin. But, the coffin was empty however..

Then, he suddenly hear footsteps from behind and the sound of a metallic blade screeching and dragging against the floor so loud.. it gives you a horrible chill and prevents you to turn back. The atmosphere somehow changed as things get colder and darker than before. He then turn around himself up bravely and quickly draw and aims his Eagle 12 to the opened door of the warehouse, but nobody was there…

Then he hears a voice of a little girl in the coffin, “Hello…” Dave then panics and yells as he turn around again but this time he sees a little girl standing in front of the coffin. The girl is wearing a tattered white dress, she looks at Dave with a smile and bows down. “It’s nice to meet you, my name is Sally.” She looked very young as Dave asks her, “Where are you from? And why are you here?”

Sally answered, “Well I was once born here, and then once I turned 13… the soldier of the Red Box Alliance attacked us and i lost my family.. I’m a weeping angel and I find no happiness inside. My knees are damaged. My hand is cold… I’m sad.. but promise me that you’ll never tell this to anyone, alright..?” Judging by the looks of her. Her knees and her hands was covered in black ink, as well as her chest..

Dave responded, “Uhh.. I will but.. please explain me what exactly happened to you..?” The little girl replied, “I was tormented and tortured by the soldiers of the Red Box Alliance.. I was running away.. I fell on my knees as I was then surrounded by a group of soldier of the Red Box Alliance and begins beating me up with their Shovel 1s… My knees, my hands, and my chest was overwhelmed with pain..”

Clearly Dave is still confused, but then he responded, “Okay, Sally.. I have understand and I’m pretty sure that everything’s okay…” He then ruffles her hair softly and hears footstep of the other patrolling men. He turns around and sees two of them coming into the warehouse.

One of the patrolling soldier asks Dave, “What are you doing here, Dave? No one is authorized to be in this Warehouse!” then Dave responded, “Oh! It’s that i found a girl here. And her name is Sally.” Then, the patrolling men steps back, shivering and shaking in fear. “Y-you’re serious… r-right..?” says the other patrolling soldier. Dave replies ,”Yes, what’s wrong?”

Then, the patrolling man answered with fear and sorrow, “That girl, Sally, was killed 5 years ago in this area.. She was beaten down by a group of Red soldiers with their Shovel 1s until she passed away.. We found the body however.. but it then disappears…” As Dave hear all of that, he begins to fill the chill crawling down on his spine and sweats in fear… Dave then replied as he turns around,”But Sally was he-” as he was about to finish the sentence, Sally was gone.

They then regroup and look around with their flashlight on.. They then see the coffin shaking, moving, then floating as they then hear the screeching and the screaming of the little girl all over the warehouse. As they are trembling and shaking with a cold chill all over their body, they hear a upcoming footstep of a bare foot in front of them. As they all aim their flashlight in front of them, they see Sally with white, tattered dress as she drags a rusty Shovel 1 to the floor with her eyes missing and screeching with her mouth wide-opened.

As they all see Sally charging towards them like that, they all screamed and hurry to the door of the Warehouse as they then try to close the door and locks it. Once they saw Sally getting close to the door and screaming in front of them, they shut and locks the door of the warehouse. Then a large metal banging was heard at the door as they hear Sally screaming and screeching behind the door. They screamed and run away, leaving the door locked and shut forever, as they will never wanted to patrol next to the warehouse ever again in the future...

title: How do you create a Table at the Forum?

posts.h:
Hello, everyone! Kagome here and I am here to give you a tutorial on how you can create a table on the Forum.


Let's begin!

Step 1. Create a thread or a post (for a post however, you will need to proceed "Advanced" in order to be ready to create yourself a table on the forum.



Step 2. Click on the "Table", located on the bottom of the B I U.



Step 3. As you clicked on the Table, you will see a new window that entitled "Table Properties". There you will see Rows, Columns, Width, Table Style, and Alignment.



Step 4. With the Table Properties window opened, you are able to edit and create the Table of your desire. You can create the amount of rows and columns you wanted to create, adjust the width of the table, set which Table Styles you want the table to be, and set which alignment you want the table to be aligned as (either to the left, center, or to the right.) I will be creating my own table where it will have 5 rows, 2 columns, width of 450, Outer Border for the Table Style, and set the alignment to Center.




Step 5. When you are done with editing and setting which table you wanted to set at the Table Properties window, press "Okay". For my Table's however, will be exactly how I wanted to set the table from the Table Properties window.










Step 6. Once your table has been created and added to your edit and post box, you are now able to edit and add any words or information you wanted to add at the Table's box. I will show you of what information I will add at my created Table below.


Hornet 96 5 Stars
Mosquito 1 4 Stars
Scarab 4.16 3 Stars
Tarantula 41 2 Stars
Wasp 25 1 Star

You have now understand on how to create a Table at the Forum!

"But Kagome, what are the other Icons beside and next to the Table button at the edit box? What are those?"



These allows you to edit the table that you selected. You are able to change the property of the Table that you selected with the Table Property window appeared (but the value for the Rows and the Columns could not be changed, but there is a way) and you are able to remove or add Rows and Columns on the Table that you selected to edit. I will remove one row at the bottom rows of the table and add another column of the table that I created (and with some another information on the table box as well.)

Hornet 96 5 Stars 26% Damage
Mosquito 1 4 Stars 24% Damage
Scarab 4.16 3 Stars 22% Damage
Tarantula 41 2 Stars 21% Damage


You have now fully understand the usage of the tables and the instructions of how to create a Table at the forum!

You played on the US-Server, but the US-Server was shut down in 2015. All US-Players had time to contact tour support and get all the tokens they bought transfered to the EU-Server, but the deadline for that is allready over.

title: How do you get a Tsunamirama

posts.h: The Tsunamirama has been on my weapons to get list for a while, it was recently on sale in the shop for about 2100 tokens, once I got enough tokens, it went off sale, but i'm guessing there are other ways to get it, if there are, what are they and how do you do them.
posts.t: How do you get a Tsunamirama

posts.h:
Hello, antyurianz.

There are several way you can win the Tsunamirama. You can either obtain the Tsunamirama by winning it from Pick 'N' Wins by using either Tokens or PNW Coins. The rare prizes that you win in Pick 'N' Board may be random so who knows what you will get from the rare items list once you uncovered the rare spots in Pick 'N' Win board (but it's best to check the list first before proceeding!) You can visit more information and how the Pick 'N' Win works here:
http://www.brick-force.com/en/game/t...s/pick-and-win

Another way to obtain the Tsunamirama is by winning on the Map of the Month contest! It will always happen every month and will announce the winners by few days later after the designated month. Map of the Month is where builders build an fantastic and hard-working map as they submit them to the Map of the Month forum to qualify and be part of the Map of the Month contest. The judges will check and inspect the map that they submitted before evaluating the map. You can either win up to 3rd place to 1st place (Well if you're really are a amazing Builder of the Month of course!) where you can win Tokens and also the Weapon of Choice!

The Weapon of Choice is where you contact the assigned Moderators regarding about your Weapon of Choice. But it's only for those who win it of course! There are many submission and many entries on the Map of the Month forum and many builders always make an amazing map for the Brick-Force community! You can check more information regarding about the rules of the Map of the Month and how to win it here:
http://www.brick-force.com/forum/sho...p-of-the-Month

Or the calmest and the patient way to receive the Tsunamirama is by purchasing them on the special offers sale (if they appear in the shop of course) You can request the items of your desire that you wanted to see in the next future sales by writing down which items you wanted to see in the shop next here:
http://www.brick-force.com/forum/sho...r-future-Sales!

We hope to see each other again in the battlefield and at the forum.

With best regards,
Kagome.

Brick-Force Defense Team-Tournament



Attention Brick-Soldiers,
Defense-Mode seems not to get the attention it deserves. So, we decided to host the Brick-Force Defense-Tournament. It will start on 08.04.2017 and show everyone: Defense-Mode is not for farming only!

When will the tournament take place?
The tournament will start on 08.04.2017. Its runtime will be determined by the number of teams participating.

How will the tournament be played?
Matches will be 3 vs. 3 only. Your team must have at least 3 members. The map will be announced by tournament officials before each round. To begin with the timeframe will be 20 minutes per match with 30 escapes.

The running order of the tournament will be released after registration is closed.

How do I win a match?
In this tournament, a match is not decided by kills, but by escaped bees. You must protect your own bees and eliminate the enemies’ bees.
To report the outcome of your match, you must post a screenshot of your results. This falls to each teams’ leader. We will prepare a thread for the match results to be posted in.

How can I participate?
To take part in the tournament, you must be a team of at least 3 players. Every team can register a 4th player for reserves. Reserve players must participate in at least one tournament-match to be eligible for tournament rewards.
The leader of your team has to register your team until the 07.04.2017, 17:00h CEST in the corresponding thread.

Important for Clans
If your clan enters multiple teams to the tournament, they will be registered as ‘Partner-Teams’. We will adjust the running order to minimize the possibility for fraud and unfair teamplay. This rule applies as soon as at least two members of the same clan are present in a team. You must inform us about your clan when your leader registers your team.

How is the running order for this tournament?
The exact running order will be set after registration is closed. There won’t be fixed dates for each match, you have to organize the match with your opponent yourself. If you are not able to organize the match until a set date, tournament officials will set a binding date.

Are there Rules?
Of course, the terms of agreement and common rules are applying. We also prepared a set of special tournament rules you must follow:
1. Every team must keep records of each match they play. This applies to the winners and the looser of the match. We do this to minimize possible fraud.
2. If even a single player of a team is caught using hacks, hacking- or other external tools or exploiting a bug, the whole team can be disqualified. Of course, normal bans will also happen.
3. If there are any irregularities during the match, one or both teams can request a rematch. Also, tournament officials can request a rematch if irregularities happen.
4. Using other grenades then flash- and smoke-grenades is forbidden! Due to reasons of fairness and deeper tactical gameplay, using any grenades except flash- and smoke-grenades can lead to negating the outcome of a single match or even the disqualification of the whole team.
5. Every team can cancel the match up to 3 times within the first minute without consequences, if one or more players made mistakes in preparing their gear, for example taking the wrong grenades or missing potions.

What can I win?
1st Place: Golden Medal and 2.500 Token for each player of the team
2nd Place: Silver Medal and 2.000 Token for each player of the team
3rd Place: Bronze Medal and 1.500 Token for each player of the team
4th – 10th Place: 1 a temporary weapon that have never been handet out befor for each player of the team
11th Place and higher: 5 Pick’n’Win-Coins for each player of the team

Please use this thread for any remarks, feedback and comments regarding this tournament. We prepared a dedicated thread for team-registration and another dedicated thread for the team leaders to post the results of their matches.

The running order will be published soon after registration closed.

Have fun,
Your Brick-Force Team

Unfortunately with the current situation, the only way to create any new content is to re-create the entire game. Unfortunately ExE left Infernum Productions with a product that was impossible to update, and as a result Infernum left Gamigo in that same position. Gamigo acquired Infernum Productions for Dragons Prophet, not Brick-Force or Hazard-Ops. This is extremely evident with how they market it alongside some of their more popular games on their main website.

Brick-Force has such a low amount of people playing the game that Gamigo wouldn't even want to think about reconstructing the game from scratch, let alone attempt it. We have to face it, from a financial standpoint, rebuilding Brick-Force would be like throwing your wallet into the ocean. You might get some of your money back, but the chances of regaining what you threw are slim.

Now with saying that, I do like to believe that if the game was re-constructed from scratch with several key aspects looked after such as balancing, performance, and advertising, then I do believe that the game has the possibility to become very successful. Infernum Productions in combination with ExE started with a fantastic, fairly balanced game; however around season 2 is when the major balancing problems began.

All in all I am disappointed that the game is next in line for the firing squad, but I am happy to know that quite a number of people got at least some enjoyment out of the game throughout the years.

Best Regards,
boopboop

Hey everyone, I was just a little curious on people's opinion on whether this game has another chance on being more populated once again. In my opinion, it definitely has since why would the game blow up back in the days? The thing that lead to the demise of the game, was simply things like armour and op weps that people had. Not everyone was willing to spend to get better weps and that's when the game turned p2w. Then the rest is history.

We can surely bounce back up if armour and weapons were BALANCED like everyone wanted years ago, and just let the players spend on stuff like skins and other minimal impact items.
Look at fortnite, they've done incredibly well and even made a mobile version available, just like what this game was going to do. Fortnite in my experience was more balanced and didn't necessarily require you to turn into a p2w player.

Brickforce can bounce back up, but as we know, we got some major issues holding us back, especially funds. But if we get that sorted somehow, and the game has been updated to be more fair, all that's left is getting the attention of people, which is quite easy now a days. So who knows what's gonna happen in the future. All I know is that if no one does any thing about it, well good bye Brickforce. What do you guys think?
